overall.assessment: Na temelju same strukture — bez pretpostavljanja pojedinosti koje se ne mogu provjeriti iz naslova podtema — podcast djeluje uglavnom usklađeno s katoličkom vjerom: povezuje osobno svećeničko i biskupsko služenje, molitvu, pastoralnu obnovu, skrb za nerođene i sjećanje na ratne patnje. Posebno je vrijedan spoj javnog svjedočenja s molitvom i konkretnim služenjem te naglašavanje da se o povijesnim ranama i crkvenim pitanjima treba razgovarati u istini. Ipak, izrazi poput „ruka spasa za svijet koji srlja u propast”, usporedba „David protiv Golijata” i snažno povezivanje vjere, rata i nacionalnog identiteta traže pažljivo tumačenje kako ne bi potisnuli Kristovo središnje mjesto, pojednostavili moralnu složenost rata ili poistovjetili kršćansku vjernost s političkim identitetom. Zato je riječ o pozitivnom, ali ne bezuvjetnom teološkom dojmu: konačna procjena sadržaja i tona zahtijevala bi uvid u sam razgovor.
seeds_of_logos: Krunica i marijanska pobožnost mogu voditi dubljem susretu s Kristom: Crkva krunicu razumije kao biblijski utemeljenu, kontemplativnu molitvu usmjerenu na spasonosna otajstva Kristova života, u zajedništvu s Marijom.
Prikaz svećeničkog i biskupskog poziva, pastoralnog rada u ratom pogođenoj župi i obnove crkava ističe služenje, postojanost i brigu za zajednicu, umjesto vjere svedene samo na privatno mišljenje.

Javno moljenje krunice može biti legitimno svjedočenje vjere i zajednička molitva, pod uvjetom da ostane usmjereno na Krista i otvoreno svim ljudima; crkveni dokumenti izrijekom preporučuju zajedničku marijansku molitvu i krunicu.

Naglasak na zaštiti nerođenih upućuje na poštovanje ljudskog života; prikaz Hoda za život kao moralne, a ne samo stranačke teme može potaknuti vjernike na javnu odgovornost, uz potrebu poštovanja dostojanstva i savjesti svakoga čovjeka.

Teme ratne patnje, razorenih župa i obnove mogu pridonijeti kulturi sjećanja i solidarnosti, ako se žrtve svih zajednica priznaju bez osvete i isključivanja. Ivan Pavao II. naglašava prava ljudi i naroda, dijalog te zabranu isključivanja manjina, pa i u ime pretjeranog nacionalizma.

Poziv da se dijalog ne vodi nauštrb istine može biti plodonosan ako istodobno uključuje pošteno slušanje, razborito povijesno istraživanje i poštovanje sugovornika; kršćansko svjedočenje treba biti spremno obrazložiti nadu s blagošću i poštovanjem.
concerns: Marijanske metafore poput „ruke spasa” zahtijevaju kristološku jasnoću: Marija se časti kao majka i zagovornica, ali krunica je usmjerena na Kristova otajstva i ne smije stvoriti dojam da je Marija neovisni izvor spasenja.

Apokaliptičan opis svijeta kao onoga koji „srlja u propast” može poticati ozbiljnost molitve, ali bez nade u Krista, razboritosti i konkretnog služenja može skliznuti u strah, moralnu paniku ili osudu društva.

Povezivanje vjere, domoljublja, ratne obrane i Stepinčeva nasljeđa traži jasno razlikovanje kršćanskog domoljublja od nacionalizma te moralne obrane od romantiziranja nasilja. Crkveni govor o miru uključuje prava naroda, ali i dijalog, poštovanje drugih i odbacivanje isključivanja.

Izraz „Psi laju, karavana prolazi” može djelovati kao odbacivanje kritike umjesto kao poziv na njezino pošteno razlučivanje; javno svjedočenje vjerodostojnije je kada odgovara istinito i bez prezira prema kritičarima.

Tvrdnje o Stepinčevoj svetosti, ratnim okolnostima i povijesnim prijeporima trebaju razlikovati pobožno poštovanje od utvrđenih činjenica i kanonskog postupka; iz samih podtema nije moguće procijeniti koliko podcast tu razliku doista čuva.
overall.theological_context: Direktorij o pučkoj pobožnosti i liturgiji te pobudnica Verbum Domini daju prikladan okvir za temu krunice: ona je kontemplativna molitva biblijskog nadahnuća koja razmatra Kristov život u zajedništvu s Marijom, pa marijanska pobožnost treba ostati kristocentrična. Socijalni okvir pruža govor Ivana Pavla II. o dostojanstvu osobe, pravima pojedinaca i naroda, solidarnosti, zajedničkom dobru, dijalogu i uključivanju manjina; taj okvir posebno je važan pri povezivanju domoljublja, rata i crkvenog svjedočenja. Dostavljeni materijali ne sadrže izravan tekst KKC-a, pa procjena ne pripisuje KKC-u pojedinačne tvrdnje koje se ovdje mogu utemeljiti na navedenim crkvenim dokumentima.

overall.assessment_en: Based on the structure itself — without assuming details that cannot be verified from the subtopic titles — the podcast appears mostly aligned with the Catholic faith: it connects personal priestly and episcopal service, prayer, pastoral renewal, care for the unborn, and remembrance of war sufferings. Particularly valuable is the combination of public witness with prayer and concrete service, as well as the emphasis that historical wounds and ecclesial issues should be discussed in truth. However, expressions such as "a saving hand for a world hurtling into ruin", the comparison "David against Goliath", and the strong linking of faith, war, and national identity require careful interpretation so as not to overshadow Christ's central place, oversimplify the moral complexity of war, or equate Christian fidelity with political identity. Therefore, this is a positive, but not unconditional theological impression: a final assessment of the content and tone would require insight into the conversation itself.
overall.theological_context_en: The Directory on Popular Piety and the Liturgy and the exhortation Verbum Domini provide an appropriate framework for the theme of the Rosary: it is a contemplative prayer of biblical inspiration that meditates on Christ's life in communion with Mary, so Marian devotion must remain Christocentric. The social framework is provided by the address of John Paul II on the dignity of the person, the rights of individuals and nations, solidarity, the common good, dialogue, and the inclusion of minorities; this framework is especially important when connecting patriotism, war, and ecclesial witness. The provided materials do not contain the direct text of the CCC, so the assessment does not attribute individual claims to the CCC that can be grounded here in the cited ecclesial documents.
seeds_of_logos_en: The Rosary and Marian devotion can lead to a deeper encounter with Christ: the Church understands the Rosary as a biblically grounded, contemplative prayer focused on the salvific mysteries of Christ's life, in communion with Mary.

The depiction of the priestly and episcopal vocation, pastoral work in a war-affected parish, and the restoration of churches highlights service, perseverance, and care for the community, rather than faith reduced merely to private opinion.

Praying the Rosary publicly can be a legitimate witness of faith and communal prayer, provided it remains focused on Christ and open to all people; Church documents explicitly recommend communal Marian prayer and the Rosary.

The emphasis on the protection of the unborn points to respect for human life; presenting the Walk for Life as a moral rather than merely partisan issue can encourage believers toward public responsibility, along with the need to respect the dignity and conscience of every human being.

Themes of war suffering, destroyed parishes, and reconstruction can contribute to a culture of remembrance and solidarity, if the victims of all communities are recognized without vengeance and exclusion. John Paul II emphasizes the rights of individuals and nations, dialogue, and the prohibition of excluding minorities, even in the name of exaggerated nationalism.

The call not to conduct dialogue at the expense of truth can be fruitful if it simultaneously includes honest listening, prudent historical research, and respect for dialogue partners; Christian witness should be ready to give an account of hope with gentleness and respect.
concerns_en: Marian metaphors such as "saving hand" require Christological clarity: Mary is venerated as mother and intercessor, but the Rosary is focused on the mysteries of Christ and must not create the impression that Mary is an independent source of salvation.

An apocalyptic description of the world as one that "hurtles into ruin" can encourage the seriousness of prayer, but without hope in Christ, prudence, and concrete service, it can slide into fear, moral panic, or condemnation of society.

Connecting faith, patriotism, wartime defense, and Stepinac's legacy requires a clear distinction between Christian patriotism and nationalism, and between moral defense and romanticizing violence. The Church's teaching on peace includes the rights of nations, but also dialogue, respect for others, and the rejection of exclusion.

The expression "The dogs bark, the caravan moves on" can seem like a rejection of criticism rather than a call for its honest discernment; public witness is more credible when it responds truthfully and without contempt toward critics.

Claims about Stepinac's holiness, wartime circumstances, and historical controversies should distinguish devout veneration from established facts and canonical process; from the subtopics alone, it is not possible to assess how well the podcast actually preserves this distinction.

sections.subtitle: Muževi s krunicom kao znak vremena: Marija kao „ruka spasa”
sections.screenshot_description: Mons. Vlado Košić govori o katoličkim muževima koji javno mole krunicu
sections.content:
Epizoda otvara jednom od najsnažnijih misli cijelog razgovora. Sisački biskup **mons. Vlado Košić** govori o pokretu muževa koji se okupljaju kako bi javno molili krunicu. Ističe da to nije samo hrvatska pojava: muževi su se već i drugdje okupljali kako bi upravo molitvom krunice svjedočili svoju vjeru.

U tome biskup vidi jasan znak. Prema njegovim riječima, *odgovorni katolički muževi* vide kako svijet „srlja u propast” i u Mariji prepoznaju „ruku spasa”. Tom rečenicom najavljena je tema na koju se razgovor kasnije vraća, ali prije toga voditelj gosta vodi kroz cijeli njegov životni put.

magisterium.assessment: Javna molitva krunice kao svjedočanstvo vjere i oslanjanje na Marijin zagovor u skladu su s katoličkim naukom. Ipak, izraz „ruka spasa” treba razumjeti slikovito: Marija zagovara i vodi Kristu, dok je Krist jedini Spasitelj.
concerns: Izraz „svijet srlja u propast” može zvučati kao nediferencirana katastrofična prosudba; odlomak ne navodi na čemu se ta ocjena temelji. Također bi trebalo jasno izbjeći dojam da Marija spašava neovisno o Kristu.
magisterium.enrichment: Krunica nije samo javno očitovanje pobožnosti nego i molitva razmatranja Kristovih otajstava, koja vjernika oblikuje prema Kristu. Crkva uči da Marija za nas zagovara, kao na svadbi u Kani, ali njezin je zagovor majčinski i potpuno usmjeren njezinu Sinu.
magisterium.assessment_en: The public prayer of the Rosary as a witness of faith and reliance on Mary's intercession are in accordance with Catholic teaching. However, the expression "hand of salvation" should be understood figuratively: Mary intercedes and leads to Christ, while Christ is the only Savior.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Rosary is not only a public manifestation of piety but also a prayer of contemplation of the mysteries of Christ, which shapes the believer according to Christ. The Church teaches that Mary intercedes for us, as at the wedding in Cana, but her intercession is maternal and completely directed to her Son.
concerns_en: The expression "the world is rushing into ruin" can sound like an undifferentiated catastrophic judgment; the passage does not state on what this assessment is based. Also, the impression that Mary saves independently of Christ should be clearly avoided.

sections.subtitle_en: Men with the Rosary as a Sign of the Times: Mary as a "Hand of Salvation"
sections.screenshot_description_en: Mons. Vlado Košić speaks about Catholic men who pray the Rosary publicly
sections.content_en:
The episode opens with one of the strongest thoughts of the entire conversation. The Bishop of Sisak, **mons. Vlado Košić**, speaks about the movement of men who gather to pray the Rosary publicly. He points out that this is not only a Croatian phenomenon: men have already gathered elsewhere as well to witness their faith precisely through the prayer of the Rosary.

In this, the bishop sees a clear sign. According to his words, *responsible Catholic men* see how the world is "rushing into ruin" and recognize in Mary a "hand of salvation". With that sentence, a topic is announced to which the conversation returns later, but before that, the host guides the guest through his entire life path.

sections.subtitle: S Kaptola na Veliki Kaptol: šaljiv uvod u razgovor sa sisačkim biskupom
sections.screenshot_description: Biskup se smije dok objašnjava razliku između zagrebačkog Kaptola i sisačkog Velikog i Malog Kaptola
sections.content:
Voditelj podcasta *Redefinicija* goste pozdravlja riječima „Hvaljen Isus i Marija i sveti Josip” te predstavlja monsinjora Vladu Košića, biskupa sisačkog. Uvodni razgovor je opušten. Voditelj pita je li bila gužva, a biskup priznaje da jest i da je studio „jedva našao”.

Zatim voditelj šaljivo pita gdje je jednostavnije biti, u Velikom ili u Malom Kaptolu. Biskup Košić objašnjava da Sisak ima i Mali i Veliki Kaptol, dok Zagreb ima „samo Kaptol”. Zato se znao šaliti kako je **„došao s Kaptola u Veliki Kaptol”**. Što se prometa tiče, dodaje, Sisak je jednostavniji, dok su gužve u Zagrebu „nekada gotovo jedva svladive”. Voditelj se slaže da nije lako živjeti u velikom gradu, ali zahvaljuje Bogu što su se upravo u Zagrebu susreli.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je u skladu s katoličkim naukom: pozdrav izražava pobožno poštovanje prema Isusu, Mariji i svetom Josipu, a šala o Kaptolu ne sadrži očitu teološku tvrdnju ni problem. Budući da je završetak citata prekinut, procjena se odnosi samo na prikazani dio.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolička pobožnost prema Mariji i svetom Josipu smješta se u širu zajednicu svetih, koja povezuje vjernike na zemlji s Crkvom u nebu i upućuje ih na Krista. Drugi vatikanski koncil ističe da čašćenje svetih vodi Kristu, izvoru milosti i života Crkve.

sections.subtitle_en: From Kaptol to Veliki Kaptol: a humorous introduction to the conversation with the Bishop of Sisak
sections.screenshot_description_en: The bishop smiles while explaining the difference between Zagreb's Kaptol and Sisak's Veliki and Mali Kaptol
sections.content_en:
The host of the podcast *Redefinicija* greets the guests with the words "Praised be Jesus and Mary and Saint Joseph" and introduces Monsignor Vlado Košić, Bishop of Sisak. The introductory conversation is relaxed. The host asks if there was traffic, and the bishop admits that there was and that he "barely found" the studio.

Then the host humorously asks where it is simpler to be, in Veliki or in Mali Kaptol. Bishop Košić explains that Sisak has both Mali and Veliki Kaptol, while Zagreb has "only Kaptol". That is why he used to joke that he **"came from Kaptol to Veliki Kaptol"**. As far as traffic is concerned, he adds, Sisak is simpler, while traffic jams in Zagreb are "sometimes almost hardly manageable". The host agrees that it is not easy to live in a big city, but thanks God that they met precisely in Zagreb.

sections.subtitle: Od Družbinca do Šalate: sretno djetinjstvo okruženo s četiri naraštaja
sections.screenshot_description: Biskup Košić prisjeća se rodnog Varaždina i obiteljskog doma u Družbincu
sections.content:
Na pitanje o prvim uspomenama biskup Košić kreće od početka. Rođen je u **Varaždinu**, a za sebe kaže da je „Varaždinec, domovine sin”. Odrastao je u obiteljskom domu u **Družbincu**, u župi **Petrijanec**. Ondje je kršten, primio prvu pričest i krizmu, a kasnije ondje slavio i mladu misu. U Petrijancu je završio i osam razreda osnovne škole.

Njegov se školski i formacijski put može sažeti ovako:
- **osnovna škola** u Petrijancu,
- **sjemenište na Šalati** u Zagrebu,
- nakon mature **vojni rok u Rumi**,
- zatim **bogoslovija na Kaptolu** u Zagrebu.

Djetinjstvo opisuje kao lijepo i sretno. Odrastao je uz roditelje i sestru, ali i uz djeda i baku, pa čak i uz pradjeda i prabaku, kojih se i danas sjeća. Selo pamti kao „prozračno”, puno životinja i prirode. Prijelaz u grad bio mu je nešto teži, no ondje se posvetio knjizi. Volio je čitati i učiti, a zajedno s kolegama u sjemeništu bavio se i sportom i glazbom. Zaključuje kako „može reći da je njegovo djetinjstvo bilo sretno”.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je uglavnom usklađen s katoličkim naukom: navodi krštenje, prvu pričest i krizmu kao dijelove osobnoga životnog puta, bez iznošenja spornih teoloških tvrdnji. Riječ je ponajprije o biografskom prikazu, pa se njegova povijesna točnost ne može prosuditi samo na temelju teološke usklađenosti.
magisterium.enrichment: Krštenje je početak kršćanskoga života, a obiteljska i crkvena zajednica pomažu da se primljena milost razvija kroz molitvu, Božju riječ i sakramentalni život. Prva pričest posebno uvodi vjernika u susret s Kristom u Euharistiji; Sveto pismo također prikazuje Isusovo odrastanje u mudrosti, dobi i milosti (Lk 2,52).

sections.subtitle_en: From Družbinec to Šalata: a happy childhood surrounded by four generations
sections.screenshot_description_en: Bishop Košić recalls his native Varaždin and family home in Družbinec
sections.content_en:
To the question about his first memories, Bishop Košić starts from the beginning. He was born in **Varaždin**, and says of himself that he is „a man from Varaždin, son of the homeland”. He grew up in the family home in **Družbinec**, in the parish of **Petrijanec**. There he was baptized, received first communion and confirmation, and later celebrated his first Mass there. In Petrijanec he also finished eight grades of primary school.

His educational and formation path can be summarized like this:
- **primary school** in Petrijanec,
- **seminary at Šalata** in Zagreb,
- after graduation **military service in Ruma**,
- then **major seminary at Kaptol** in Zagreb.

He describes his childhood as beautiful and happy. He grew up alongside his parents and sister, but also alongside his grandfather and grandmother, and even alongside his great-grandfather and great-grandmother, whom he still remembers today. He remembers the village as „airy”, full of animals and nature. The transition to the city was somewhat harder for him, but there he dedicated himself to books. He loved to read and study, and together with his colleagues in the seminary he also engaged in sports and music. He concludes that „he can say that his childhood was happy”.

sections.subtitle: Zašto se ne čuje varaždinski naglasak: biskup o standardnom jeziku
sections.screenshot_description: Biskup govori o važnosti standardnog hrvatskog jezika i pravilnih naglasaka u javnom govoru
sections.content:
Voditelj primjećuje da se kod gosta ne osjeti varaždinski naglasak i da je teško pogoditi odakle je. Biskup Košić objašnjava da je to plod truda. Njegovi učitelji, i u osnovnoj školi u Petrijancu i u srednjoj školi u Zagrebu, imali su jasan stav da učenici trebaju usvojiti **standardni hrvatski književni jezik**, s pravilnim naglascima i razlikovanjem *č* i *ć*.

Priznaje da se danas zavičajni govor tolerira, pa čak i potiče, i smatra da je to lijepo. Ipak, drži da javne osobe svakako trebaju znati standardni jezik. Drago mu je kad ljudi ne mogu pogoditi otkud je, pa ga pitaju je li iz Slavonije. Uz smijeh dodaje da se ipak čuje da nije iz Dalmacije.

Ne skriva ni da mu u javnosti smetaju „ružni naglasci, baš na prvi slog”. Zbog toga se, kaže, ljuti, „ali što si mogu pomoći, nitko mene ne pita”.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak govori o jezičnoj normi i javnom govoru, a ne iznosi tvrdnju koja bi se protivila katoličkom nauku ili Svetom pismu. Njegova je teološka relevantnost ograničena, pa se na temelju prikazanog teksta ne može zaključiti da aktivno produbljuje katolički nauk.
magisterium.enrichment: Važno je razlikovati praktičnu preporuku o standardnom jeziku od vjerske ili moralne obveze: opisani stav o pravilnom javnom govoru sam po sebi nije teološko pitanje. Budući da je odlomak prekinut prije dovršetka misli o javnom govoru, nije moguće pouzdano procijeniti njezine dodatne nijanse.
magisterium.assessment_en: The excerpt speaks about linguistic norms and public speaking, and does not make a claim that would oppose Catholic teaching or Sacred Scripture. Its theological relevance is limited, so based on the presented text it cannot be concluded that it actively deepens Catholic teaching.
magisterium.enrichment_en: It is important to distinguish a practical recommendation regarding the standard language from a religious or moral obligation: the described stance on proper public speaking is not in itself a theological question. Since the excerpt was cut off before the completion of the thought on public speaking, it is not possible to reliably assess its additional nuances.

sections.subtitle_en: Why the Varaždin accent cannot be heard: bishop on the standard language
sections.screenshot_description_en: The bishop speaks about the importance of standard Croatian language and proper accents in public speaking
sections.content_en:
The host notes that the Varaždin accent cannot be sensed in the guest and that it is difficult to guess where he is from. Bishop Košić explains that this is the fruit of effort. His teachers, both in elementary school in Petrijanec and in high school in Zagreb, held a clear stance that students should adopt the **standard Croatian literary language**, with proper accents and distinguishing *č* and *ć*.

He admits that today local speech is tolerated, and even encouraged, and he considers that to be nice. Nevertheless, he maintains that public figures should certainly know the standard language. He is glad when people cannot guess where he is from, so they ask him if he is from Slavonija. With a laugh, he adds that one can still hear he is not from Dalmacija.

He does not hide either that in public he is bothered by “ugly accents, right on the first syllable”. Because of that, he says, he gets angry, “but what can I do, nobody asks me”.

sections.subtitle: Ispit iz latinskog i proročanstvo župnika: „Ti buš župnik!”
sections.screenshot_description: Biskup prepričava kako je kao dječak položio ministrantski ispit iz latinskog
sections.content:
Na pitanje kako je razlučio svećenički poziv, biskup Košić najprije govori o obitelji. Bila je to **pobožna obitelj** koja je zajedno molila kod kuće i redovito išla na misu. Župnik ih je rado posjećivao, iako inače nije bio otvoren za mnogo susreta s vjernicima. Razlog je bio težak: partizani su mu ubili brata na kućnom pragu, a htjeli su ubiti i njega. Onima kod kojih je dolazio, međutim, bio je prijatelj i imao je povjerenja u njih, a jedna od tih obitelji bila je i Košićeva.

Malog Vladu fasciniralo je kako se oko župnika okupljaju ministranti, pa je i sam htio ministrirati. Prepreka je bio ispit iz latinskog. Bilo je to oko 1969. ili 1970., kad je pohađao četvrti razred. Od četvorice dječaka jedan je slomio ruku, pa je pouka prekinuta. Vlado nije odustao. Poručio je preko zvonara župniku da je „sve naučio”, iako latinske odgovore, priznaje, nije razumio. Župnik ga je ispitao i pustio, a dječak je **trčao kući i skakao od veselja** jer je postao ministrant.

Obitelj je njegovu želju podupirala. Biskup se prisjeća i pokojnog kapucina **fra Ilije Boraka**, koji ga je jednom upitao: „Vlado, buš kapucin?”, a on je odgovorio: „Bum.” Ipak, župnik **Antun Posavec** imao je drukčiji plan. Rekao mu je da neće biti ni kapucin ni isusovac, kojih je upoznao na trodnevnom susretu ministranata na Šalati, nego: „**Ti buš župnik.**” Mali Vlado inače je govorio da će biti „ili župnik ili poljoprivrednik”. Odabrao je prvo i nakon osnovne škole otišao na Šalatu.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je u skladu s katoličkim razumijevanjem obitelji kao važnog mjesta molitve i sazrijevanja svećeničkih zvanja. Opisuje osobno iskustvo, a ne tvrdi da pobožna obitelj ili župnikovo predviđanje sami po sebi dokazuju poziv ili određuju nečiji životni put.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva ističe da zajednička obiteljska molitva i život vjere mogu pripremiti plodno tlo za svećenički poziv, ali Bog može pozvati i u drukčijim okolnostima, a odgovor na poziv uključuje osobno i slobodno razlučivanje. U biblijskom smislu, odgovor „Evo me, mene pošalji!” (Iz 6,8) izražava spremnost na Božji poziv; obitelj i župna zajednica mogu tu spremnost poticati, ali ne trebaju nametati unaprijed određeno zvanje.

citations.document_title: To students of the Roman Major Seminary (March 20, 1983) - Speech
The Truth and Meaning of Human Sexuality: Guidelines for Education Within the Family
citations.document_author: The Pontifical Council for the Family

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is in accordance with the Catholic understanding of the family as an important place of prayer and the maturation of priestly vocations. It describes personal experience and does not claim that a pious family or a parish priest's prediction in themselves prove a vocation or determine someone's life path.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church emphasizes that communal family prayer and the life of faith can prepare fertile ground for a priestly vocation, but God can also call in different circumstances, and the response to a call involves personal and free discernment. In the biblical sense, the response „Here am I; send me!” (Is 6:8) expresses readiness for God's call; the family and the parish community can encourage this readiness, but should not impose a predetermined vocation.

sections.subtitle_en: Latin exam and the parish priest's prophecy: „You will be a parish priest!”
sections.screenshot_description_en: The bishop recounts how as a boy he passed the altar server Latin exam
sections.content_en:
To the question of how he discerned his priestly vocation, Bishop Košić first speaks about his family. It was a **pious family** that prayed together at home and regularly went to Mass. The parish priest gladly visited them, although otherwise he was not open to many encounters with the faithful. The reason was difficult: partisans had killed his brother on their doorstep, and they wanted to kill him as well. To those he visited, however, he was a friend and had confidence in them, and one of those families was Košić's.

Little Vlado was fascinated by how altar servers gathered around the parish priest, so he wanted to serve as an altar server himself. The obstacle was the Latin exam. It was around 1969 or 1970, when he was attending fourth grade. Of the four boys, one broke his arm, so the instruction was interrupted. Vlado did not give up. He sent word to the parish priest through the bell-ringer that he had „learned everything”, although the Latin responses, he admits, he did not understand. The parish priest examined him and let him pass, and the boy **ran home and jumped for joy** because he had become an altar server.

The family supported his desire. The bishop also recalls the late Capuchin **fra Ilija Borak**, who once asked him: „Vlado, will you be a Capuchin?”, and he answered: „I will.” Nevertheless, the parish priest **Antun Posavec** had a different plan. He told him that he would be neither a Capuchin nor a Jesuit, whom he had met at a three-day meeting of altar servers at Šalata, but: „**You will be a parish priest.**” Little Vlado otherwise used to say that he would be „either a parish priest or a farmer”. He chose the former and after elementary school went to Šalata.

sections.subtitle: Generacija '78.: prijateljstva koja traju gotovo pola stoljeća
sections.screenshot_description: Biskup govori o godišnjim susretima maturanata generacije 1978.
sections.content:
Na Šalati se, kaže, pronašao. Imao je dobre ocjene, cijenili su ga poglavari i profesori, a dobro se slagao i s kolegama. Ta se prijateljstva njeguju i danas. Maturanti **generacije '78.** sastaju se svake godine, a za dvije godine slavit će **50 godina mature**.

Susreti su se održavali na raznim mjestima. Posljednji je bio u Dragancu kod Čazme, prethodni u Sračincu kod Varaždina, a biskup je dvaput bio domaćin u Sisku. Za 50. obljetnicu, ako Bog da, kolege će ponovno pozvati k sebi. U generaciji su i oni koji su se ostvarili u civilnom i obiteljskom životu, a petnaestak ih je postalo svećenicima. Susreti uvijek imaju isti tijek: sveta misa, ručak, razgovor i zajedničko fotografiranje. Povezuje ih i zajednička skupina na WhatsAppu.

Posebne veze ima i s generacijom zaređenom **1985.**, kada je i sam postao svećenik. I s njima slavi obljetnice.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je biografski i opisuje dugotrajna prijateljstva među bivšim sjemeništarcima bez tvrdnji koje bi proturječile katoličkom nauku ili Svetom pismu. Njegov naglasak na trajnoj povezanosti i zajedništvu u skladu je s kršćanskim vrednovanjem vjernog prijateljstva i svećeničkog bratstva.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkveno razumijevanje sjemenišne formacije uključuje ne samo studij i duhovni rast nego i zrele odnose prijateljstva, koji mogu podupirati zajedništvo i služenje. Biblijska mudrost opisuje vjernog prijatelja kao dragocjenu potporu, osobito kad se odnos vjerno njeguje kroz vrijeme; zato su ovakva okupljanja vrijedna kao izraz ljudske zahvalnosti i povezanosti, premda sama po sebi nisu poseban vjerski čin.

citations.document_title: To the students of the Pontifical Lombard Seminary, Castel Gandolfo (September 15, 1990) - Speech
“What is Man?” (Ps 8:5). An itinerary of biblical anthropology

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is biographical and describes long-lasting friendships among former seminarians without claims that would contradict Catholic teaching or Sacred Scripture. Its emphasis on lasting connection and fellowship is in accordance with the Christian valuation of faithful friendship and priestly brotherhood.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church's understanding of seminary formation includes not only studies and spiritual growth, but also mature relationships of friendship, which can support fellowship and service. Biblical wisdom describes a faithful friend as precious support, especially when the relationship is faithfully nurtured over time; therefore, gatherings of this kind are valuable as an expression of human gratitude and connection, although in themselves they are not a specific religious act.

sections.subtitle_en: Class of '78: friendships that last almost half a century
sections.screenshot_description_en: The bishop speaks about the annual reunions of graduates of the class of 1978.
sections.content_en:
At Šalata, he says, he found himself. He had good grades, superiors and professors appreciated him, and he got along well with his classmates. Those friendships are nurtured even today. Graduates of the **class of '78** meet every year, and in two years they will celebrate **50 years of graduation**.

The reunions were held in various places. The last one was in Draganac near Čazma, the previous one in Sračinec near Varaždin, and the bishop hosted twice in Sisak. For the 50th anniversary, God willing, he will invite his classmates to his home again. In the class there are also those who realized themselves in civilian and family life, and about fifteen of them became priests. The gatherings always have the same course: Holy Mass, lunch, conversation, and a group photograph. They are also connected by a shared group on WhatsApp.

He also has special bonds with the class ordained in **1985**, when he himself became a priest. He celebrates anniversaries with them as well.

sections.subtitle: Od Dubovca do Hrastovice: župa koju je rat razorio
sections.screenshot_description: Biskup opisuje izbijanje rata i progonstvo svoje župe u Hrastovici
sections.content:
Nakon ređenja Vlado Košić bio je tri godine kapelan u **Karlovcu na Dubovcu**, a zatim dvije godine u **Španskom u Zagrebu**. Nakon pet godina kapelanske službe dobio je svoju prvu župu, **Hrastovicu kod Petrinje**. Bilo je to 1990., godinu dana prije rata.

Ljude u Hrastovici brzo je zavolio, a oni njega. Zajedno su pokrenuli mnoge duhovne i materijalne inicijative. U rat, priznaje, isprva nije vjerovao: „Kakav rat, to su se neke tri budale napile.” Ipak, sukob je eskalirao. Župa je morala bježati, svi su bili prognani, a bilo je i poginulih. Mladi župnik obilazio je ljude, tješio ih i pokapao svoje poginule.

Prisjeća se početaka hrvatske vojske, tadašnjeg ZNG-a, i nemoći branitelja. Kad je zarobljeni **Đuro Vranečan** u snimci preko radija upitan je li se u crkvi dijelilo oružje, nasmijao se i odgovorio da je kod crkve imao „stražu sa štapom”. „Nismo se imali čime braniti, a oni su imali”, zaključuje biskup.

Opisuje i razmjere razaranja. Okupirano je bilo sve južno od Kupe i Save, a ondje se nalazilo **14 župa**, uz kapele, župne kuće i samostane. „Sve porušeno, sve su uništili”, kaže, jer je cilj bio da nestane „sve što je katoličko” na tom području. Najviše je stradalo 1991., ali razaranje je trajalo sve do oslobođenja 1995.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je pretežno biografski i povijesni prikaz svećeničkog služenja i ratnog iskustva te ne iznosi tvrdnje koje bi bile protivne katoličkom nauku ili Svetom pismu. Budući da je tekst prekinut, procjena se odnosi samo na prikazani dio.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolička perspektiva na ratnu patnju uključuje solidarnost sa stradalima, obnovu zajednica i zauzimanje za mir; Ivan Pavao II. hrvatske je pastire pozvao da budu „apostoli mira i obnove” te da vjernici ne podlegnu mržnji i osveti, nego se otvore oproštenju i pomirenju. Takav kontekst pomaže razumjeti obnovu župe ne samo kao materijalni pothvat nego i kao pastoralnu brigu za ljude i za ponovno uspostavljanje života zajednice.

citations.document_title: To the Bishops of the Croatian Episcopal Conference on their ad limina visit (November 9, 1992) - Speech

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is predominantly a biographical and historical account of priestly ministry and wartime experience and does not put forward claims contrary to Catholic teaching or Sacred Scripture. Since the text is truncated, the assessment pertains only to the presented portion.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Catholic perspective on wartime suffering includes solidarity with the victims, the renewal of communities, and the pursuit of peace; John Paul II called upon Croatian pastors to be „apostles of peace and renewal” and for the faithful not to succumb to hatred and revenge, but to open themselves to forgiveness and reconciliation. Such a context helps in understanding the renewal of the parish not only as a material undertaking, but also as pastoral care for the people and for the reestablishment of community life.

sections.subtitle_en: From Dubovac to Hrastovica: a parish destroyed by the war
sections.screenshot_description_en: The bishop describes the outbreak of the war and the exile of his parish in Hrastovica
sections.content_en:
After his ordination, Vlado Košić was a chaplain for three years in **Karlovac at Dubovac**, and then for two years in **Špansko in Zagreb**. After five years of chaplaincy service, he received his first parish, **Hrastovica near Petrinja**. That was in 1990, a year before the war.

He quickly grew fond of the people in Hrastovica, and they of him. Together they launched many spiritual and material initiatives. In the war, he admits, he did not believe at first: „What war, some three fools got drunk.” Still, the conflict escalated. The parish had to flee, everyone was exiled, and there were also fatalities. The young parish priest visited the people, comforted them, and buried his fallen.

He recalls the beginnings of the Croatian army, the then-ZNG, and the powerlessness of the defenders. When the captured **Đuro Vranečan** was asked in a radio recording whether weapons were being distributed in the church, he laughed and answered that at the church he had a „guard with a stick”. „We had nothing to defend ourselves with, and they did,” the bishop concludes.

He also describes the scale of the destruction. Everything south of the Kupa and Sava was occupied, and **14 parishes** were located there, along with chapels, parish houses, and monasteries. „Everything demolished, they destroyed everything,” he says, because the goal was for „everything that is Catholic” to disappear from that area. The greatest destruction occurred in 1991, but the destruction lasted all the way until the liberation in 1995.

sections.subtitle: Tri godine na prvoj crti: barake, vreće s pijeskom i vjeronauk
sections.screenshot_description: Biskup govori o životu uz kapelu Svetog Jakova u Mošćenici tijekom rata
sections.content:
Nakon progonstva boravio je s kolegama u Petrinji, zatim u Maloj Gorici, a najduže u Selima. Tada ga je **kardinal Kuharić** imenovao župnikom Petrinje, iako sama Petrinja nije bila dostupna. Pod kontrolom je ostala samo kapela u **Mošćenici**, selu između Siska i Petrinje.

Ondje je postavio drvenu baraku, a vjernici su, kako sam naglašava, obnovili kapelu **Svetog Jakova**. Uz nju je proživio **tri godine na prvoj crti**. Vodio je Caritas i brinuo se za ljude. Kako je u školi bilo više stotina djece, nije ni pomišljao na odlazak: „Zašto bih ja bježao ako su djeca tu?” Predavao je vjeronauk u toj školi i u gimnaziji u Sisku.

Prisjeća se slike koju bi danas „teško netko zamislio”: **vreće s pijeskom na prozorima**, jer je svakog trena mogla pasti granata. „Ali smo se ipak držali, nismo se dali i izdržali smo do kraja”, kaže.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je biografski prikaz svećeničke službe tijekom rata, a opis skrbi za vjernike, Caritasa i djelovanja uz zajednicu na teško dostupnom području u skladu je s katoličkim razumijevanjem pastoralne službe. U navedenom sadržaju nema tvrdnje koja bi se protivila katoličkom nauku ili Svetom pismu; ocjena se odnosi na sažetak, ne na neizrečene dijelove razgovora.
magisterium.enrichment: Katoličko shvaćanje pastirske službe naglašava da je ona služenje povjereno po uzoru na Krista, Pastira Crkve. Papa Ivan Pavao II. ističe da se pastoralna skrb očituje i u odgovoru na društvene potrebe ljudi, dok crkveni naglasak na pomoći stradalima, obnovi zajednica i solidarnosti daje dodatni kontekst opisanom radu u ratnim okolnostima.

citations.document_title: 14 January 1980: Santa Messa all'apertura del Sinodo dei Vescovi olandesi - Homily
To the clergy, religious and seminarians at the Cathedral of Saint Stanislaw in Vilnius (September 4, 1993) - Speech

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is a biographical account of priestly ministry during the war, and the description of caring for the faithful, Caritas, and working alongside the community in a hard-to-reach area is in accordance with the Catholic understanding of pastoral ministry. In the aforementioned content, there is no claim that would oppose Catholic teaching or Sacred Scripture; the assessment pertains to the summary, not to unstated parts of the conversation.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Catholic understanding of pastoral ministry emphasizes that it is a service entrusted after the model of Christ, the Shepherd of the Church. Pope John Paul II emphasizes that pastoral care is also manifested in responding to the social needs of people, while the Church's emphasis on helping victims, rebuilding communities, and solidarity provides additional context to the described work in wartime conditions.

sections.subtitle_en: Three years on the front line: barracks, sandbags, and religious education
sections.screenshot_description_en: The bishop speaks about life beside the chapel of Saint James in Mošćenica during the war
sections.content_en:
After the exile, he stayed with colleagues in Petrinja, then in Mala Gorica, and longest in Sela. At that time, **Cardinal Kuharić** appointed him pastor of Petrinja, even though Petrinja itself was not accessible. Only the chapel in **Mošćenica**, a village between Sisak and Petrinja, remained under control.

There he set up a wooden barrack, and the faithful, as he himself emphasizes, restored the chapel of **Saint James**. Beside it, he spent **three years on the front line**. He led Caritas and took care of the people. Since there were several hundred children in the school, he did not even think about leaving: "Why would I flee if the children are here?" He taught religious education in that school and in the gymnasium in Sisak.

He recalls an image that today "hardly anyone could imagine": **sandbags on the windows**, because a shell could fall at any moment. "But we still held on, we did not give up, and we endured until the end," he says.

sections.subtitle: Iz pastoralne službe na fakultet i najmlađi biskup u HBK-u
sections.screenshot_description: Biskup navodi da je danas najstariji biskup po ređenju u HBK-u
sections.content:
Godine 1995. izabran je za asistenta na **Katoličkom bogoslovnom fakultetu**. Dvije godine bio je asistent, a nakon doktorata viši asistent. Na katedri dogmatske teologije predavao je četiri do pet dogmatskih traktata, a predavao je i na Katehetskom institutu. Nastavnik na KBF-u ostao je sve do 2005.

U međuvremenu, **6. veljače 1999.**, zaređen je za zagrebačkog pomoćnog biskupa, zajedno s biskupom **Josipom Mrzljakom**. Zato je danas, kaže, **najstariji biskup po ređenju u HBK-u**. U Zagrebu je bio pomoćni biskup jedanaest godina, a u Sisku mu teče sedamnaesta godina službe.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak iznosi biografske podatke i ne sadrži tvrdnju koja bi bila u suprotnosti s katoličkim naukom ili Svetim pismom. Ipak, budući da uglavnom ne izlaže teološki nauk, ne može se ocijeniti kao odlomak koji ga aktivno produbljuje.
concerns: Tvrdnja da je mons. Košić „najstariji biskup po ređenju u HBK-u” biografska je i vremenski ovisna; dostavljeni izvori ne potvrđuju njezinu točnost.
magisterium.enrichment: Biskupsko ređenje nije samo počasni naslov: ono biskupu povjerava službe posvećivanja, poučavanja i upravljanja, u apostolskom nasljedstvu. Katoličko shvaćanje biskupske službe naglašava njezino služenje Kristu i Božjem narodu, a ne prvenstvo u rangu ili osobnu važnost; zato prvenstvo po datumu ređenja ne podrazumijeva veću svetost ni veću vlast od one koju određuje crkveno poslanje.

citations.document_title: The 'munus docendi' of the bishop in light of c. 747 §1 and the Synod of Bishops of 2001. Second part, 2003, Issue 1, pp. 21–75

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage presents biographical data and does not contain any statement that would be contrary to Catholic teaching or Sacred Scripture. However, since it largely does not expound theological teaching, it cannot be assessed as a passage that actively deepens it.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Episcopal ordination is not merely an honorary title: it entrusts the bishop with the offices of sanctifying, teaching, and governing, in apostolic succession. The Catholic understanding of the episcopal ministry emphasizes its service to Christ and the People of God, not precedence in rank or personal importance; therefore, precedence by date of ordination does not imply greater holiness or greater authority than that determined by ecclesial mission.
concerns_en: The claim that Msgr. Košić is "the oldest bishop by ordination in the HBK" is biographical and time-dependent; the provided sources do not confirm its accuracy.

sections.subtitle_en: From pastoral ministry to the faculty and the youngest bishop in the HBK
sections.screenshot_description_en: The bishop states that today he is the oldest bishop by ordination in the HBK
sections.content_en:
In 1995, he was elected as an assistant at the **Catholic Faculty of Theology**. For two years he was an assistant, and after his doctorate, a senior assistant. At the chair of dogmatic theology, he taught four to five dogmatic treatises, and he also taught at the Catechetical Institute. He remained an instructor at the KBF until 2005.

In the meantime, on **February 6, 1999**, he was ordained an auxiliary bishop of Zagreb, together with Bishop **Josip Mrzljak**. That is why today, he says, he is the **oldest bishop by ordination in the HBK**. In Zagreb he was an auxiliary bishop for eleven years, and in Sisak his seventeenth year of ministry is underway.

sections.subtitle: Noć uoči „Oluje”: slalom između tenkova s maticama u autu
sections.screenshot_description: Biskup prepričava noć kad su tenkovi stigli do kapele u Mošćenici uoči oslobođenja
sections.content:
Voditelj se vraća ratnim godinama, koje je biskup opisao u knjizi ***Župnik na prvoj crti***, i preporučuje je svima. Podsjeća i na detalj da su biskup i njegova kuharica dan prije oslobođenja mogli izgubiti život.

Biskup objašnjava da su vojnici akciju držali u tajnosti, iako su mu obećali da će ga upozoriti. Ipak je osjećao da se nešto sprema. Noć prije napada **tenkovi su stigli do same kapele u Mošćenici**. Izašao je i upitao kreću li u oslobađanje. Kad su potvrdili, rekao je da bi se onda bilo bolje maknuti, a oni su se složili.

U auto je spremio knjige i **župne matice** i krenuo „kao u nekom slalomu između tenkova” prema Zagrebu. Na putu od Siska prema Selima, oko pet sati ujutro, čuo je početak kanonade, artiljerijsku pripremu za oslobađanje Banovine. „Bogu hvala, to se brzo riješilo”, kaže, „ali je zapravo jako velika cijena.”

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je pretežno biografski prikaz ratnog iskustva svećenika i ne iznosi tvrdnju koja bi očito proturječila katoličkom nauku ili Svetom pismu. Ipak, budući da je riječ o kratkom i djelomičnom ulomku, njegovu povijesnu točnost ni pravednost konkretnih vojnih djelovanja nije moguće procijeniti samo na temelju teksta.
concerns: Naziv „oslobođenje” pojavljuje se kao opis događaja, ali sam po sebi ne dokazuje moralnu pravednost vojne akcije; katolička prosudba rata i uporabe sile zahtijeva razmatranje konkretnih okolnosti i moralnih kriterija.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolička tradicija ne smatra svaku vojnu službu ili obranu unaprijed grešnom, ali legitimnost oružane obrane ne znači da je svaki postupak u ratu dopušten. Kršćanska prosudba zato istodobno može uvažiti služenje u obrani drugih i ozbiljno shvatiti moralnu težinu nasilja, bez automatskog uzdizanja rata ili demoniziranja protivnika.
magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is predominantly a biographical account of a priest's war experience and makes no claim that would obviously contradict Catholic teaching or Sacred Scripture. Nevertheless, since this is a short and partial excerpt, its historical accuracy and the justice of specific military actions cannot be evaluated solely on the basis of the text.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic tradition does not consider every military service or defense to be inherently sinful, but the legitimacy of armed defense does not mean that every action in war is permissible. Christian judgment can therefore simultaneously appreciate service in defense of others and take seriously the moral gravity of violence, without automatically exalting war or demonizing opponents.
concerns_en: The term “liberation” appears as a description of events, but does not in itself prove the moral justice of a military action; the Catholic judgment of war and the use of force requires consideration of concrete circumstances and moral criteria.

sections.subtitle_en: The night before “Storm”: slalom between tanks with parish registers in the car
sections.screenshot_description_en: The bishop recounts the night when tanks arrived at the chapel in Mošćenica on the eve of liberation
sections.content_en:
The host returns to the war years, which the bishop described in the book ***Župnik na prvoj crti***, and recommends it to everyone. He also recalls the detail that the bishop and his cook could have lost their lives the day before the liberation.

The bishop explains that the soldiers kept the operation secret, even though they had promised him they would warn him. Still, he felt that something was brewing. The night before the attack, **tanks arrived right up to the chapel in Mošćenica**. He went out and asked if they were setting out to liberate. When they confirmed, he said that it would then be better to leave, and they agreed.

He packed books and **parish registers** into the car and set off “as in some slalom between tanks” toward Zagreb. On the way from Sisak toward Sela, around five o'clock in the morning, he heard the beginning of the cannonade, the artillery preparation for the liberation of Banovina. “Thank God, that was resolved quickly,” he says, “but it is actually a very high price.”

sections.subtitle: Cijena slobode: priča o zapovjedniku Predragu Matanoviću
sections.screenshot_description: Biskup emotivno govori o poginulom zapovjedniku Predragu Matanoviću
sections.content:
Kao primjer te cijene biskup navodi **Predraga Matanovića**, kojega opisuje i u knjizi. Vjenčao ga je s njegovom **Natalijom** u kapeli Svetog Jakova, a poslije ga je i pokopao. Natalija je na sprovodu bila u visokoj trudnoći. „Ružna, teška situacija”, kaže biskup.

Matanović je bio hrabar čovjek. Bazu je imao u vojarni u Lađarskoj ulici u Sisku, gdje su bili **Gromovi**. Suborci su ga cijenili i voljeli jer je kao pirotehničar znao proći kroz minska polja, ući neprijatelju u zaleđe i točno znati gdje se tko nalazi.

Biskup ipak naglašava da „nisu bile dobre komande”. Kasnije analize pokazale su da je napad iz Mošćenice prema Petrinji bio taktički krivo postavljen, pa su poginuli mnogi. Za dan-dva smjer je promijenjen: vojska je preko pontonskog mosta kod **Letovanića prema Nebojanu** ušla u zaleđe Petrinje, na cestu prema Glini. Kad su se našli opkoljeni, neprijatelji su pobjegli prema Dvoru i Petrinja je oslobođena.

S obiteljima poginulih branitelja i civila biskup je povezan i danas, iako su neki roditelji u međuvremenu preminuli. „Upisao sam se u živote tih ljudi i oni u moj život”, zaključuje.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je uglavnom usklađen s katoličkim naukom: s poštovanjem prikazuje poginulog branitelja, njegovu obiteljsku tragediju i hrabrost, bez izričitog opravdavanja nasilja ili rata. Ipak, iz sažetka se ne može procijeniti moralna opravdanost pojedinih ratnih postupaka, a katoličko vrednovanje hrabrosti ne znači da su sva sredstva ili postupci u ratu moralno dopušteni.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolička tradicija priznaje pravo na obranu nevinih od teškog zla, ali istodobno naglašava cijenu rata, poštovanje ljudskog života i moralna ograničenja uporabe sile. Ivan Pavao II. ističe da se žrtva i vjernost dužnosti mogu poštovati, a da sjećanje na poginule ujedno potiče na rad za mir i pomirenje.

citations.document_author: United States Conference of Catholic Bishops

citations.document_title: 19 November 2000: Jubilee of Arm Forces and Police - Homily

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is largely aligned with Catholic teaching: it respectfully portrays the fallen defender, his family tragedy, and courage, without explicitly justifying violence or war. Nevertheless, from the summary it is not possible to assess the moral justification of particular wartime actions, and the Catholic valuation of courage does not mean that all means or actions in war are morally permissible.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic tradition recognizes the right to defend the innocent against grave evil, but at the same time emphasizes the cost of war, respect for human life, and the moral limits on the use of force. John Paul II emphasizes that sacrifice and fidelity to duty can be respected, while the memory of the fallen simultaneously encourages work for peace and reconciliation.

sections.subtitle_en: The Price of Freedom: The Story of Commander Predrag Matanović
sections.screenshot_description_en: The bishop speaks emotionally about the fallen commander Predrag Matanović
sections.content_en:
As an example of that price, the bishop cites **Predrag Matanović**, whom he also describes in the book. He married him to his **Natalija** in the chapel of Sveti Jakov, and later he also buried him. Natalija was heavily pregnant at the funeral. "An ugly, difficult situation," says the bishop.

Matanović was a brave man. He had his base in the barracks on Lađarska ulica in Sisak, where the **Gromovi** were. His fellow combatants appreciated and loved him because, as a deminer, he knew how to pass through minefields, enter the enemy's rear, and know exactly where everyone was.

The bishop nevertheless emphasizes that "the commands were not good." Later analyses showed that the attack from Mošćenica toward Petrinja was tactically wrongly set up, so many died. In a day or two, the direction was changed: the army entered the hinterland of Petrinja via a pontoon bridge at **Letovanić toward Nebojan**, onto the road toward Glina. When they found themselves surrounded, the enemies fled toward Dvor and Petrinja was liberated.

The bishop remains connected with the families of fallen defenders and civilians even today, although some parents have passed away in the meantime. "I have written myself into the lives of those people and they into my life," he concludes.

sections.subtitle: Biskup s 39 godina: imenovanje koje je obitelj dočekala „jaukanjem”
sections.screenshot_description: Biskup govori o iznenađenju zbog imenovanja i o tome da je bio najmlađi biskup
sections.content:
Na pitanje je li očekivao biskupsko imenovanje, biskup Košić odgovara da nije. Iznenađenje je bio već izbor za asistenta na fakultetu. Kad ga je **profesor Golub** pitao bi li se prijavio na natječaj, odgovorio je da je deset godina nakon diplome već „prestar” i da u ratu nije stigao studiozno raditi. Golub mu je savjetovao da se pomoli i, ako želi, prijavi. Prijavio se misleći da ga neće izabrati. Od trojice kandidata dvojica su bila doktori znanosti, a on magistar, no profesori su izabrali njega. Morao je ostaviti župu, ali, kaže, vjernike nikad zapravo nije ostavio.

Imenovan je **29. prosinca 1998.**, a zaređen **6. veljače 1999.** u zagrebačkoj katedrali. Imao je tada oko 39 i pol godina, pa je bio vjerojatno među najmlađim biskupima u Europi. **Nadbiskup Bozanić** ispričao mu je da su mu iz Rima prigovorili kako je kandidat premlad. Bozanić je odgovorio da je i sam u toj dobi postao biskup, i to ordinarij, krčki biskup. Biskup Mrzljak sve je sažeo riječima: „Obećali smo poslušnost.”

Iza smiješnih scena krila se teška borba. „Bio sam jako potresen i bilo mi je jako teško”, priznaje. Kad je novinar *Glasa Koncila* **Miklenić** došao razgovarati s njegovom obitelji, ukućani su govorili: „To je teško Vladi sada.” Prema biskupovim riječima, „više su jaukali nego slavili”. Službu je prihvatio kao **križ** i nosi ga, kaže, do danas.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je uglavnom usklađen s katoličkim razumijevanjem poziva: prikazuje molitvu, razborito razlučivanje i spremnost prihvatiti službu koja nije bila očekivana. Riječ je pretežno o osobnom svjedočanstvu, pa sam odlomak ne izlaže cjelovit nauk o svećeničkom ili biskupskom pozivu.
magisterium.enrichment: Katoličko razlučivanje poziva uključuje molitvu, ali i crkveno prosuđivanje sposobnosti i prikladnosti kandidata; zato neizvjesnost oko ishoda sama po sebi ne znači da se poziv ne može prihvatiti. Crkva biskupsku službu razumije kao poslanje služenja, a ne kao čast radi osobnog položaja; taj kontekst može obogatiti opis iznenađenja zbog imenovanja.

citations.document_title: De Ordinatione Episcopi, Presbyterorum et Diaconorum (The Ordination of Bishops, Priests, and Deacons)

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is largely aligned with the Catholic understanding of vocation: it portrays prayer, prudent discernment, and the readiness to accept a ministry that was not expected. It is primarily a personal testimony, so the passage itself does not present a complete teaching on the priestly or episcopal vocation.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic discernment of vocation includes prayer, but also ecclesial evaluation of the candidate's abilities and suitability; therefore, uncertainty about the outcome does not in itself mean that the call cannot be accepted. The Church understands the episcopal ministry as a mission of service, and not as an honor for personal status; this context can enrich the description of the surprise at the appointment.

sections.subtitle_en: A Bishop at 39 Years of Age: An Appointment That the Family Met with "Wailing"
sections.screenshot_description_en: The bishop speaks about the surprise regarding the appointment and about being the youngest bishop
sections.content_en:
To the question of whether he expected the episcopal appointment, Bishop Košić answers that he did not. Even his selection as an assistant at the faculty was a surprise. When **Professor Golub** asked him if he would apply for the competition, he replied that ten years after graduation he was already "too old" and that during the war he had not had time to work studiously. Golub advised him to pray and, if he wished, apply. He applied thinking they would not choose him. Of the three candidates, two held doctorates, and he held a master's degree, but the professors chose him. He had to leave the parish, but, he says, he never actually left the faithful.

He was appointed on **December 29, 1998**, and ordained on **February 6, 1999**, in the Zagreb Cathedral. He was then about 39 and a half years old, so he was probably among the youngest bishops in Europe. **Archbishop Bozanić** told him that people from Rome objected to him that the candidate was too young. Bozanić replied that he himself had become a bishop at that age, and an ordinary at that, the Bishop of Krk. Bishop Mrzljak summarized everything with the words: "We promised obedience."

Behind the funny scenes lay a difficult struggle. "I was deeply shaken and it was very difficult for me," he admits. When the journalist of *Glas Koncila* **Miklenić** came to talk with his family, the household members said: "This is hard for Vlado now." According to the bishop's words, "they wailed more than they celebrated." He accepted the ministry as a **cross** and carries it, he says, to this day.

sections.subtitle: Rođenje Sisačke biskupije: radost unatoč „misijskom” teretu
sections.screenshot_description: Biskup objašnjava zašto se radovao osnivanju Sisačke biskupije
sections.content:
Voditelj pita što je bilo teže: postati biskup ili preuzeti novu, obnovljenu biskupiju s mnogo posla. Biskup bez dvojbe odgovara da je teže bilo postati biskup. Kardinal ih je obavijestio da ih je papa već imenovao. Odbiti se moglo samo zbog vrlo ozbiljnih razloga, uz dokaze ili liječničke potvrde, pa su, kaže, bili „dovedeni pred gotov čin”.

Osnivanju **Sisačke biskupije** se, naprotiv, radovao. Poznavao je taj kraj i njegove ljude, a i oni su poznavali njega. Prisjeća se kako je **pater Bonaventura Duda**, kad mu je spomenuo da se radi na osnivanju biskupije, rekao: „**To će biti misijska biskupija.**”

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je uglavnom usklađen s katoličkim naukom: imenovanje biskupa pripada nadležnoj crkvenoj vlasti, a osnivanje biskupije i služenje njezinim vjernicima prikazani su kao crkvene zadaće. Tvrdnja da se imenovanje moglo odbiti samo iz vrlo ozbiljnih razloga iznesena je kao opis konkretnog iskustva, ali dostupni izvori ne potvrđuju takvo ograničenje kao opće pravilo.
concerns: Opis mogućnosti odbijanja imenovanja ne treba tumačiti kao opće kanonsko pravilo: navedeni kanon potvrđuje da Vrhovni Svećenik slobodno imenuje biskupe, ali ne navodi da su ozbiljni razlozi i dokazi jedini mogući temelj za odbijanje.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkveni nauk opisuje biskupsku službu kao apostolsko poslanje i služenje, a ne samo kao upravnu dužnost; biskupi su pozvani naviještati Evanđelje i pastirski voditi povjerenu Crkvu. Uređenje biskupija i imenovanje biskupa pripadaju nadležnoj crkvenoj vlasti, dok se u postupku imenovanja uzimaju u obzir i savjeti crkvenih osoba te, na prikladan način, vjernika dotične biskupije.
magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is largely aligned with Catholic teaching: the appointment of bishops belongs to the competent ecclesiastical authority, and the establishment of a diocese and serving its faithful are presented as ecclesial tasks. The assertion that an appointment could be refused only for very serious reasons is presented as a description of a concrete experience, but available sources do not confirm such a restriction as a general rule.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Church teaching describes the episcopal office as an apostolic mission and service, and not merely as an administrative duty; bishops are called to proclaim the Gospel and pastorally guide the entrusted Church. The governance of dioceses and the appointment of bishops belong to the competent ecclesiastical authority, while in the appointment process the counsel of ecclesiastical persons and, in an appropriate manner, of the faithful of the respective diocese are also taken into account.
concerns_en: The description of the possibility of refusing an appointment should not be interpreted as a general canonical rule: the cited canon confirms that the Supreme Pontiff freely appoints bishops, but does not state that serious reasons and evidence are the only possible basis for refusal.

sections.subtitle_en: The Birth of the Diocese of Sisak: Joy Despite the “Missionary” Burden
sections.screenshot_description_en: The bishop explains why he rejoiced at the establishment of the Diocese of Sisak
sections.content_en:
The host asks what was more difficult: becoming a bishop or taking over a new, renewed diocese with a lot of work. The bishop answers without doubt that it was more difficult to become a bishop. The cardinal informed them that the pope had already appointed them. One could refuse only for very serious reasons, with evidence or medical certificates, so they were, he says, “presented with a fait accompli”.

He rejoiced, on the contrary, at the establishment of the **Diocese of Sisak**. He knew that region and its people, and they also knew him. He recalls how **Father Bonaventura Duda**, when he mentioned to him that work was being done on the establishment of the diocese, said: “**That will be a missionary diocese.**”

sections.subtitle: Mučenička biskupija i predziđe kršćanstva
sections.screenshot_description: Biskup govori o svetom Kvirinu i pojmu antemurale christianitatis
sections.content:
Biskup Košić Sisačku biskupiju naziva **mučeničkom**. Kroz povijest su ondje ljudi stalno ginuli: od turskih osvajanja, preko partizanskih zločina i protjerivanja, do Domovinskog rata, a na kraju je došao i potres. Kao najzorniji primjer navodi **Zrin**, župu koja je potpuno uništena: ljudi su pobijeni i protjerani, a sve je porušeno.

Zaštitnik biskupije je **sveti Kvirin**, sisački biskup i mučenik. Biskup ističe da je to područje bilo **predziđe kršćanstva**, *antemurale christianitatis*. Taj je izraz upotrijebio **papa Lav X.** u pismu iz 1509. upućenom **Petru Berislaviću** nakon njegove pobjede nad Turcima kod Dubice.

Naglašava da pritom nije riječ samo o obrani Zapada ili Europe. Hrvati su kao vjernici branili kršćanstvo, jer su tada „kršćanstvo i Europa” bili isto. Ta kršćanska Europa, kaže, danas više ne postoji, ali na ta područja i dalje „navaljuju i nasrću”, a mučeništvo traje. „Bogu hvala, još smo tu”, zaključuje.

magisterium.assessment: Izraz „mučenička biskupija” može biti razumljiv kao pastoralna slika područja obilježenog teškim stradanjima, a sveti Kvirin doista je naveden među kršćanskim mučenicima iz hrvatskih krajeva. Ipak, odlomak ne razgraničuje mučeništvo u strogom kršćanskom smislu od drugih žrtava rata, zločina, progona ili potresa, pa je njegova teološka preciznost djelomična.
concerns: U katoličkom govoru mučenik je osoba koja podnosi smrt zbog vjere u Krista ili zbog vjernosti kršćanskoj istini; zato se žrtve rata, zločina, protjerivanja ili potresa ne mogu samo na temelju stradanja nazvati mučenicima. Izraz „mučenička biskupija” može se koristiti preneseno, ali trebalo bi jasno naznačiti da nije riječ o tvrdnji kako su svi stradali mučenici u strogom smislu.
Odlomak tvrdi da je izraz *antemurale christianitatis* upotrijebio papa Lav X., ali ta povijesna tvrdnja nije potvrđena dostupnim izvorima; zbog toga ostaje neprovjerena u ovoj procjeni.
magisterium.enrichment: Kršćansko mučeništvo nije opći naziv za svaku tragičnu smrt: bitno je svjedočenje Kristu i podnošenje smrti „zbog njegova imena”. Crkva istodobno može s poštovanjem pamtiti i moliti za sve žrtve nasilja i nesreća, ne izjednačujući njihove okolnosti s mučeništvom. Spominjanje svetoga Kvirina pruža konkretnu vezu s mučeničkom baštinom toga kraja, jer je naveden među mučenicima hrvatskih krajeva.

citations.document_title: 5 October 1980: Pastoral visit to Otranto - Homily

magisterium.assessment_en: The expression “martyred diocese” can be understood as a pastoral image of an area marked by severe suffering, and Saint Quirinus is indeed listed among the Christian martyrs from Croatian regions. Nevertheless, the passage does not delineate martyrdom in the strict Christian sense from other victims of war, crimes, expulsions, or earthquakes, so its theological precision is partial.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Christian martyrdom is not a generic term for every tragic death: what is essential is witnessing to Christ and enduring death “for the sake of his name.” At the same time, the Church can respectfully remember and pray for all victims of violence and accidents, without equating their circumstances with martyrdom. The mention of Saint Quirinus provides a concrete connection to the martyrial heritage of that region, as he is listed among the martyrs of Croatian regions.
concerns_en: In Catholic discourse, a martyr is a person who endures death for faith in Christ or for fidelity to Christian truth; therefore, victims of war, crimes, expulsions, or earthquakes cannot be called martyrs solely on the basis of suffering. The expression “martyred diocese” can be used figuratively, but it should be clearly indicated that this is not an assertion that all who perished are martyrs in the strict sense.

The passage asserts that the expression *antemurale christianitatis* was used by Pope Leo X, but this historical claim is not confirmed by available sources; for this reason, it remains unverified in this assessment.

sections.subtitle_en: Martyred Diocese and Bulwark of Christianity
sections.screenshot_description_en: The bishop speaks about Saint Quirinus and the term antemurale christianitatis
sections.content_en:
Bishop Košić calls the Diocese of Sisak **martyred**. Throughout history, people have constantly died there: from Turkish conquests, through Partisan crimes and expulsions, to the Homeland War, and in the end an earthquake came as well. As the clearest example he cites **Zrin**, a parish that was completely destroyed: the people were slaughtered and expelled, and everything was razed to the ground.

The patron of the diocese is **Saint Quirinus**, Bishop of Sisak and martyr. The bishop emphasizes that this area was the **bulwark of Christianity**, *antemurale christianitatis*. That expression was used by **Pope Leo X** in a 1509 letter addressed to **Petar Berislavić** following his victory over the Turks near Dubica.

He stresses that this is not only about the defense of the West or Europe. As believers, Croats defended Christianity, because back then “Christianity and Europe” were one and the same. That Christian Europe, he says, no longer exists today, but against these regions they continue to “assail and attack,” and the martyrdom endures. “Thank God, we are still here,” he concludes.

sections.subtitle: Biskup graditelj: dvostruko više srušenih crkava nego u ratu
sections.screenshot_description: Biskup iznosi brojke o obnovi 52 crkvena objekta nakon potresa
sections.content:
Voditelj podsjeća na biskupovu izjavu da će ga jednog dana zvati **biskupom graditeljem**. Biskup Košić potvrđuje da je to „zapalo” njega. Nakon Domovinskog rata ostala je *terra combusta*, spaljena zemlja, ali je do njegova dolaska u Sisak 2010. većina crkava već bila obnovljena. Ostale su tri: u Gori, u Hrvatskoj Kostajnici i u Maloj Solini. Na njima je počeo raditi, a onda je došao potres.

Brojke koje navodi govore same za sebe:
- **52 crkvena objekta** u obnovi ili izgradnji,
- od toga **28 župnih crkava**, dvostruko više od 14 stradalih u ratu,
- 14 do 15 kapela koje su spomenici kulture,
- pet do šest župnih kuća, dva samostana i crkveni muzej,
- **16 objekata završeno**, još četiri mogla bi biti gotova ove godine, a 30 se intenzivno obnavlja.

Obnova ide preko biskupije, a biskup osobno nadzire radove i potpisuje ugovore. Poznaje projektante, statičare i izvođače, od kojih pet-šest tvrtki radi dobro. Investitor je **Ministarstvo kulture**, a prvi dio financirao je **Fond solidarnosti Europske unije**. Danas gotovo svaki mjesec otvara i blagoslivlja po jednu crkvu.

Nakon potresa od **29. prosinca 2020.** biskupija je već 2021. nabavila **14 montažnih dvorana**, pa su vjernici tih župa mogli slaviti euharistiju. Ostale su se župe snalazile u župnim i društvenim dvoranama. Uz osmijeh dodaje da je nekima sada žao napustiti dvorane, jer su ondje imali grijanje i klimu, a nova crkva, „makar lijepa”, zna biti hladna. Procjenjuje da će obnova trajati još dvije do tri godine. Voditelj dodaje da biskup ne gradi samo crkve, nego i vjerničku zajednicu, a biskup skromno odgovara: „Pokušavam.”

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak prikazuje obnovu crkava nakon rata i potresa kao pastoralni i zajednički pothvat, što je u skladu s katoličkim shvaćanjem da crkvene građevine služe bogoslužju i okupljanju vjernika. Ne iznosi nauk koji bi proturječio Svetom pismu ili crkvenom nauku, ali je pretežno informativan, a ne izričito teološki.
concerns: Naslovna tvrdnja o dvostruko većem broju srušenih crkava nego u ratu u dostavljenom ulomku nije obrazložena niti ju je na temelju ovog teksta moguće provjeriti; to je činjenično pitanje, a ne samo po sebi teološki problem.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkvena zgrada ima važno, ali ne apsolutno značenje: ona je mjesto okupljanja, molitve i susreta Boga i ljudi, dok je živa Crkva zajednica vjernika. Papa Benedikt XVI. povezuje obnovu hrama s obnovom naroda, a Ivan Pavao II. ističe da poslijeratna obnova treba obuhvatiti i kršćansku zajednicu i civilno društvo.

citations.document_title: 10 December 2006: Pastoral visit to Our Lady Star of Evangelization Parish and Dedication of the new Church
Apostolic Journey to Sarajevo: To the Bishops of Bosnia-Herzegovina (April 13, 1997) - Speech

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage presents the reconstruction of churches after the war and earthquake as a pastoral and communal undertaking, which is in accordance with the Catholic understanding that church buildings serve for divine worship and the gathering of the faithful. It does not set forth teaching that would contradict Sacred Scripture or church teaching, but is predominantly informative rather than explicitly theological.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The church building has an important, but not absolute, significance: it is a place of gathering, prayer, and encounter between God and man, while the living Church is the community of believers. Pope Benedict XVI connects the reconstruction of the temple with the renewal of the people, and John Paul II emphasizes that post-war reconstruction must encompass both the Christian community and civil society.
concerns_en: The headline claim of twice as many destroyed churches as in the war is neither substantiated in the provided excerpt nor is it possible to verify it on the basis of this text; that is a factual question, and not in itself a theological problem.

sections.subtitle_en: Bishop builder: twice as many destroyed churches as in the war
sections.screenshot_description_en: The bishop presents figures on the reconstruction of 52 church structures after the earthquake
sections.content_en:
The host recalls the bishop's statement that one day they will call him the **bishop builder**. Bishop Košić confirms that this „fell to” him. After the Homeland War, what remained was *terra combusta*, scorched earth, but by his arrival in Sisak in 2010, most of the churches had already been rebuilt. Three remained: in Gora, in Hrvatska Kostajnica, and in Mala Solina. He began working on them, and then the earthquake struck.

The figures he cites speak for themselves:
- **52 church structures** under reconstruction or construction,
- of that **28 parish churches**, twice as many as the 14 damaged in the war,
- 14 to 15 chapels that are cultural monuments,
- five to six parish houses, two monasteries, and a church museum,
- **16 structures completed**, another four could be finished this year, and 30 are being intensively reconstructed.

The reconstruction goes through the diocese, and the bishop personally oversees the works and signs the contracts. He knows the designers, structural engineers, and contractors, of which five to six companies do good work. The investor is the **Ministry of Culture**, and the first part was financed by the **European Union Solidarity Fund**. Today, almost every month, he opens and blesses one church.

After the earthquake of **December 29, 2020**, already in 2021 the diocese procured **14 prefabricated halls**, so the faithful of those parishes could celebrate the Eucharist. The remaining parishes managed in parish and community halls. With a smile, he adds that some are now sorry to leave the halls, because there they had heating and air conditioning, and a new church, „though beautiful”, can be cold. He estimates that the reconstruction will last another two to three years. The host adds that the bishop does not build only churches, but also the community of believers, and the bishop humbly replies: „I am trying.”

sections.subtitle: Mamine pjesme o Gospi i petnaest godina na čelu mariološkog instituta
sections.screenshot_description: Biskup govori o pjesmama svoje majke o Blaženoj Djevici Mariji
sections.content:
Voditelj podsjeća da je biskup predavao mariologiju, pisao knjige i pjesme o Mariji te organizirao simpozije i izdavanje zbornika. Pita ga koliko mu je Marija važna. „Ona je meni jako draga i veoma važna”, odgovara biskup. Odrastao je uz **majčine pjesme o Blaženoj Djevici**, koje mu i danas „odzvanjaju u uhu i srcu”. Kao dijete volio je svibanjske i listopadske pobožnosti, a to se, kaže, „otisne čovjeku u dušu”.

Član je **Hrvatskog mariološkog instituta**, a bio mu je i predsjednik. Naslijedio je **profesora Rebića**, koji je institut vodio 25 godina, a sam ga je vodio 15 godina. Nakon njega deset je godina na čelu bio **Ivan Karlić**. Sada je u tijeku prijelazno razdoblje u kojem se statut usklađuje sa statutom KBF-a.

Institut je organizirao **tuzemne simpozije** koji su istraživali mariološku baštinu pojedinih biskupija, pa je jedan održan i u Sisku, a drugi u Dubrovniku, Splitu i Đakovačko-osječkoj nadbiskupiji. Članovi su zapaženo sudjelovali i na **međunarodnim kongresima**: tri puta u Rimu i u **Lurdu** 2008., o 150. obljetnici ukazanja iz 1858. Biskup je potaknuo i da se posljednji kongres održi u **Međugorju**, kako bi teologija dala svoj doprinos razumijevanju onoga što se ondje događa.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak prikazuje osobnu pobožnost Blaženoj Djevici Mariji i marijanske molitvene običaje, što je u skladu s crkvenim naukom; ne iznosi tvrdnje koje bi proturječile Svetom pismu ili katoličkoj vjeri. Crkva potiče osobnu i zajedničku marijansku pobožnost, koja se razlikuje od klanjanja pripadajućeg Bogu i treba voditi Kristu.
magisterium.enrichment: Svibanjske i listopadske pobožnosti pripadaju različitim oblicima pučke pobožnosti, koji se mogu njegovati uz poštovanje prvenstva liturgije i liturgijske godine. Marijanska pobožnost je najplodnija kada je ukorijenjena u Svetom pismu i usmjerava vjernike prema Kristu; primjerice, marijanske molitve mogu potaknuti razmatranje evanđeoskih otajstava.

The Church encourages personal and communal Marian devotion, which differs from the adoration due to God and should lead to Christ.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The May and October devotions belong to various forms of popular piety, which can be cultivated while respecting the primacy of the liturgy and the liturgical year.
