sections.subtitle_en: Mother's Songs About Our Lady and Fifteen Years at the Head of the Mariological Institute
sections.screenshot_description_en: The bishop speaks about his mother's songs about the Blessed Virgin Mary
sections.content_en:
The host recalls that the bishop taught mariology, wrote books and poems about Mary, and organized symposiums and the publication of proceedings. He asks him how important Mary is to him. “She is very dear to me and very important,” the bishop responds. He grew up with **his mother's songs about the Blessed Virgin**, which even today “resonate in his ear and heart.” As a child, he loved the May and October devotions, and that, he says, “imprints itself on a person's soul.”

He is a member of the **Hrvatski mariološki institut**, and was also its president. He succeeded **professor Rebić**, who led the institute for 25 years, while he himself led it for 15 years. After him, **Ivan Karlić** was at the helm for ten years. A transitional period is currently underway in which the statute is being aligned with the statute of KBF.

The institute organized **domestic symposiums** that investigated the mariological heritage of individual dioceses, so one was held in Sisak, and others in Dubrovnik, Split, and the Đakovačko-osječka nadbiskupija. The members also participated notably in **international congresses**: three times in Rome and in **Lourdes** in 2008, on the 150th anniversary of the apparitions of 1858. The bishop also encouraged that the last congress be held in **Međugorje**, so that theology could make its contribution to understanding what is happening there.

sections.subtitle: Hrvati kao marijanski narod i kajkavska baština o Mariji
sections.screenshot_description: Biskup govori o kajkavskim propovjednicima i svom doktoratu o Franji Ksaveru Pejačeviću
sections.content:
Biskup Košić smatra da su mariologija i marijanska pobožnost jako važne za hrvatski narod. Navodi tezu jednog teologa da su narodi koji su mnogo propatili posebno marijanski, a kao primjere taj je teolog istaknuo poljski, meksički i hrvatski narod. Biskup nije siguran je li to rekao **Suenens** ili netko drugi, ali misao je zapisao u svojoj **mariološkoj skripti**, objavljenoj u *Kršćanskoj sadašnjosti*. Želio bi je ažurirati i izdati kao knjižicu, „ali nema vremena”, a sugovornik mu u tome dovršava misao.

Posebno je volio staru **kajkavsku mariološku baštinu** propovjednika iz 17. i 18. stoljeća. Kajkavski je tada bio književni jezik Hrvatske, *reliquiae reliquiarum olim*, i bio je vrlo razvijen. Kao primjer navodi **Belostenčev** latinsko-kajkavski rječnik. U toj baštini ima mnogo pobožnosti, ali i dogmatske dubine, ovisno o autoru i vremenu.

Za doktorat je proučavao **Franju Ksavera Pejačevića** iz 18. stoljeća. U njegovim dogmatskim radovima na latinskom traktati o Mariji nalaze se uz kristologiju i obuhvaćaju četiri marijanske dogme. Biskup ističe da Hrvatima to „nije samo forma ili ukras”.

magisterium.assessment: Naglašavanje važnosti marijanske pobožnosti i njezine povezanosti s poviješću i kulturom naroda uglavnom je u skladu s katoličkim naukom: Crkva prepoznaje različite narodne oblike marijanske pobožnosti i njezinu posebnu ulogu u životu, primjerice, poljskog i meksičkog naroda. Tvrdnja da narodi koji su mnogo propatili posebno postaju marijanski može se razumjeti kao opažanje o povijesnoj pobožnosti, ali nije nauk vjere niti je u odlomku potkrijepljena kao opće pravilo.
concerns: Nije jasno na kojeg se teologa misao odnosi, a govornik i sam izražava nesigurnost oko autorstva.
Povezivanje kolektivnog stradanja s marijanskom pobožnošću može biti preširoko ako se predstavi kao nužna uzročna veza ili bitno obilježje Hrvata, Poljaka i Meksikanaca.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolička Crkva vrednuje narodne oblike marijanske pobožnosti kada oni vjernike vode dubljoj vjeri i nasljedovanju Krista; različiti kulturni izrazi pobožnosti mogu odražavati ukorijenjenost Evanđelja u pojedinim narodima. Marija je osobito bliska ljudima koji trpe, a njezino sudjelovanje uz Sina u njegovoj muci pruža kršćanski okvir za razumijevanje patnje, no Kristovo otkupljenje ostaje središnje i jedinstveno.

magisterium.assessment_en: Emphasizing the importance of Marian devotion and its connection with the history and culture of a people is generally in accordance with Catholic teaching: the Church recognizes various popular forms of Marian devotion and its special role in the life of, for example, the Polish and Mexican peoples. The claim that nations that have suffered a lot especially become Marian can be understood as an observation about historical devotion, but it is not a teaching of the faith nor is it substantiated in the passage as a general rule.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Catholic Church values popular forms of Marian devotion when they lead the faithful to a deeper faith and the following of Christ; various cultural expressions of devotion can reflect the rootedness of the Gospel in individual peoples. Mary is particularly close to people who suffer, and her participation beside the Son in His passion provides a Christian framework for understanding suffering, but Christ's redemption remains central and unique.
concerns_en: It is not clear which theologian the thought refers to, and the speaker himself expresses uncertainty regarding authorship.
Connecting collective suffering with Marian devotion can be overly broad if presented as a necessary causal connection or an essential characteristic of Croats, Poles, and Mexicans.

sections.subtitle_en: Croats as a Marian People and the Kajkavian Heritage Concerning Mary
sections.screenshot_description_en: The bishop speaks about Kajkavian preachers and his doctorate on Franjo Ksaver Pejačević
sections.content_en:
Bishop Košić considers that Mariology and Marian devotion are very important for the Croatian people. He cites the thesis of a theologian that nations that have suffered a lot are particularly Marian, and as examples that theologian singled out the Polish, Mexican, and Croatian peoples. The bishop is not sure whether **Suenens** or someone else said that, but he wrote down the thought in his **Mariological script**, published by *Kršćanska sadašnjost*. He would like to update it and publish it as a booklet, „but there is no time,” and his interlocutor finishes the thought for him.

He particularly loved the old **Kajkavian Mariological heritage** of 17th- and 18th-century preachers. Kajkavian was then the literary language of Croatia, *reliquiae reliquiarum olim*, and was very developed. As an example, he mentions **Belostenec's** Latin-Kajkavian dictionary. In that heritage there is much devotion, but also dogmatic depth, depending on the author and the period.

For his doctorate, he studied **Franjo Ksaver Pejačević** from the 18th century. In his dogmatic works in Latin, the treatises on Mary are found alongside Christology and encompass four Marian dogmas. The bishop emphasizes that for Croats this is „not just form or decoration.”

sections.subtitle: „Pjevajte, Kraljice Hrvata”: marijanski papa i hrvatski identitet
sections.screenshot_description: Biskup prepričava kako je papa Ivan Pavao II. hrvatske biskupe poticao da pjevaju Kraljici Hrvata
sections.content:
Kad Hrvati Mariju nazivaju **Kraljicom Hrvata**, zagovornicom i najvjernijom majkom, to je, ističe biskup, nešto „duboko sraslo s našim narodom, poviješću i identitetom”. Vjeruje da ta veza narod čuva i vodi ga da bude vjeran Kristu, kao što je to bila i Marija.

Prisjeća se kako je **sveti papa Ivan Pavao II.** volio tu pjesmu. Tijekom posjeta Hrvatskoj 1994. u Splitu je s mladima pjevao „Zdravo Djevo, kraljice Hrvata”. Kad su mu hrvatski biskupi kasnije došli u pohod *ad limina*, rekao im je: „**Pjevajte, Kraljice Hrvata, o Majko mila**”, jer je zapamtio riječi i htio je pjevati s njima.

Biskup ga naziva **duboko marijanskim papom** i podsjeća da je o toj temi održao predavanje, objavljeno u zborniku izdanom u papinu čast. Zaključuje uvjerenjem da marijanska pobožnost može pomoći hrvatskom narodu da sačuva svoj identitet i „ide dalje u budućnost pravim putem”.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je uglavnom snažno usklađen s katoličkim naukom: marijanski naslov „Kraljica Hrvata” prikazan je kao pobožni izraz, a Marijina povezanost s hrvatskim narodom usmjerena je prema vjernosti Kristu, ne umjesto njega. Marijino majčinsko zagovorništvo i njezino kraljevsko dostojanstvo utemeljeni su u katoličkom nauku, pod uvjetom da se njezina uloga razumije kao podređena Kristu i ovisna o njemu.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva uči da je Marija Kraljica zbog svojega božanskog majčinstva i sudjelovanja u Kristovu djelu spasenja; njezino kraljevstvo ne umanjuje Kristovo jedinstveno gospodstvo, nego o njemu ovisi. Naslov „Kraljica Hrvata” može se razumjeti kao narodni izraz marijanske pobožnosti, a ne kao tvrdnja da Marija pripada samo jednom narodu ili da je neki narod iznad drugih. Marijanska pobožnost ostaje autentično kršćanska kada, po uzoru na Mariju, vodi prema Kristu i vjernosti njegovu Evanđelju.
magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is largely strongly aligned with Catholic teaching: the Marian title “Queen of the Croats” is presented as a devotional expression, and Mary’s connection with the Croatian people is directed toward faithfulness to Christ, not instead of him. Mary’s maternal intercession and her royal dignity are grounded in Catholic teaching, provided that her role is understood as subordinate to Christ and dependent upon him.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church teaches that Mary is Queen because of her divine motherhood and participation in Christ’s work of salvation; her queenship does not diminish Christ’s unique lordship, but depends upon it. The title “Queen of the Croats” can be understood as a popular expression of Marian devotion, rather than as a claim that Mary belongs only to one nation or that one nation is above others. Marian devotion remains authentically Christian when, following Mary’s example, it leads toward Christ and fidelity to his Gospel.

sections.subtitle_en: “Sing, Queen of the Croats”: A Marian Pope and Croatian Identity
sections.screenshot_description_en: The bishop recounts how Pope John Paul II encouraged Croatian bishops to sing to the Queen of the Croats
sections.content_en:
When Croats call Mary the **Queen of the Croats**, advocate, and most faithful mother, that is, the bishop emphasizes, something “deeply grown into our people, history, and identity.” He believes that this bond preserves the people and leads them to be faithful to Christ, just as Mary was.

He recalls how **Saint Pope John Paul II** loved that song. During his visit to Croatia in 1994, he sang “Hail, Virgin, Queen of the Croats” with young people in Split. When the Croatian bishops later came to him for the *ad limina* visit, he told them: “**Sing, Queen of the Croats, o dear Mother**,” because he remembered the words and wanted to sing with them.

The bishop calls him a **deeply Marian pope** and recalls that he gave a lecture on that topic, published in a proceedings volume issued in the pope's honor. He concludes with the conviction that Marian devotion can help the Croatian people preserve their identity and “go forward into the future on the right path.”

sections.subtitle: Biskup koji je odlučio sam provjeriti: susret s moliteljima na trgu
sections.screenshot_description: Mons. Vlado Košić objašnjava zašto se nije oslanjao na medijske napise, nego je sam došao na javnu molitvu krunice
sections.content:
Razgovor o ljubavi prema Gospi voditelj podcasta **Redefinicija** povezuje s konkretnim iskustvom. Podsjeća da je sisački biskup **mons. Vlado Košić** nekoliko puta sudjelovao na javnoj molitvi krunice. Prvi put to je bilo u **srpnju 2023. u Zagrebu**, a drugi put u **Sisku, u siječnju ove godine**. Voditelj otvoreno priznaje da se o moliteljima pisalo svašta i da mnogi u javnosti nisu uspjeli trezveno i objektivno prosuditi o čemu je riječ. Zato ga zanima kako je biskup doživio to prvo iskustvo na trgu i kako je o njemu kasnije razmišljao.

Odgovor mons. Košića jednostavan je i izravan. Želio je *vidjeti svojim očima*. Kako kaže, nije **nasjeo pričama, napisima ni kritikama**, nego se htio sam uvjeriti. Otišao je i bilo mu je drago što je sudjelovao jer, prema vlastitim riječima, *tu nije vidio nikakvih problema*. To je i javno govorio. Posebno ističe da je zadovoljan što se na tim okupljanjima ne događa ništa protivno Crkvi ni kršćanskoj vjeri.

Biskup otkriva da je osim u Zagrebu i Sisku jednom molio i u **Popovači**. Najavljuje i novi dolazak: molitelji su ga pozvali da u Sisku **blagoslovi njihovu novu zastavu**, pa planira doći na sljedeću molitvu, prve subote u lipnju.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je pretežno opisni: navodi biskupovo sudjelovanje u javnoj molitvi krunice i postavlja pitanje o njegovu iskustvu, bez iznošenja tvrdnje koja bi bila protivna katoličkom nauku ili Svetom pismu. Zajednička molitva krunice u skladu je s crkvenim poticanjem osobne i zajedničke marijanske molitve, ali sam odlomak ne iznosi dovoljno sadržaja za ocjenu kasnijih tvrdnji o moliteljima.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolička tradicija krunicu razumije kao molitvu koja s Marijom razmatra Kristova otajstva i usmjerava vjernika Kristu, a ne kao zamjenu za njega. Ivan Pavao II. potvrđuje vrijednost zajedničkog moljenja krunice, dok Benedikt XVI. ističe njezinu povezanost sa Svetim pismom i razmatranjem Kristova života.

Rosarium Virginis Mariae on the Most Holy Rosary

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is predominantly descriptive: it states the bishop's participation in the public Rosary prayer and poses a question about his experience, without making any claim contrary to Catholic teaching or Sacred Scripture. Communal prayer of the Rosary is in accordance with the Church's encouragement of personal and communal Marian prayer, but the passage itself does not present enough content to assess subsequent claims about those praying.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic tradition understands the Rosary as a prayer that, with Mary, contemplates the mysteries of Christ and directs the believer to Christ, rather than as a substitute for Him. John Paul II confirms the value of praying the Rosary together, while Benedict XVI emphasizes its connection with Sacred Scripture and contemplation of the life of Christ.

sections.subtitle_en: A bishop who decided to check for himself: an encounter with those praying on the square
sections.screenshot_description_en: Msgr. Vlado Košić explains why he did not rely on media reports, but came himself to the public Rosary prayer
sections.content_en:
The host of the **Redefinicija** podcast connects the conversation about love for Our Lady with a concrete experience. He recalls that the bishop of Sisak, **Msgr. Vlado Košić**, participated several times in the public Rosary prayer. The first time was in **July 2023 in Zagreb**, and the second time in **Sisak, in January of this year**. The host openly admits that all sorts of things were written about those praying and that many in the public failed to judge soberly and objectively what it was about. That is why he is interested in how the bishop experienced that first experience on the square and how he later reflected on it.

Msgr. Košić's answer is simple and direct. He wanted to *see with his own eyes*. As he says, he did not **fall for stories, reports, or criticisms**, but wanted to convince himself. He went and was glad to have participated because, according to his own words, *he saw no problems there*. He also spoke about this publicly. He particularly emphasizes that he is satisfied that nothing contrary to the Church or the Christian faith happens at those gatherings.

The bishop reveals that, in addition to Zagreb and Sisak, he also prayed once in **Popovača**. He also announces a new arrival: those praying invited him to **bless their new flag** in Sisak, so he plans to come to the next prayer, on the first Saturday of June.

sections.subtitle: „Nešto proročko“: krunica kao ruka spasa za svijet koji srlja u propast
sections.screenshot_description: Biskup Košić govori da je javna molitva krunice proročki znak vremena
sections.content:
Najsnažniju misao ovog dijela razgovora mons. Košić izgovara kada promišlja širi smisao pokreta. Kada o tome *malo više razmisli*, kaže, čini mu se da je riječ o **znaku vremena**. Sam priznaje da ne zna točno kakav je to znak, ali u toj pojavi vidi *nešto proročko*. Naglašava da pokret nije nastao samo u Hrvatskoj. Prije toga postojao je u **Poljskoj**, a i drugdje su se okupljali muževi koji su željeli svjedočiti svoju vjeru upravo moleći krunicu.

Biskup to tumači kao znak da **odgovorni katolički muževi vide kako svijet srlja u propast** i da u Mariji vide, kako kaže tražeći pravu riječ, *ruku spasa*. Prema njegovim riječima, molitelji žele da Gospa svojim zagovorom:

- **utvrdi katoličke muževe**,
- **ojača katoličke obitelji**, kako bi one doista bile ono što bi trebale biti,
- pomogne vjernicima da se **odupru navalama i zamkama** koje se danas postavljaju pred njih.

Svoje promišljanje zaključuje ozbiljnom dijagnozom suvremenog trenutka: kako i sami gledatelji vide, *sve je više zla u koje tone čitav svijet*. Javnu molitvu krunice zato ne doživljava kao folklor ni kao demonstraciju, nego kao duhovni odgovor na krizu vremena.

magisterium.assessment: Opis javnog moljenja krunice kao mogućeg znaka vremena i „nečega proročkog” uglavnom je usklađen s katoličkim naukom, osobito zato što govornik svoju prosudbu iznosi oprezno, a ne kao sigurnu objavu. Takvo tumačenje valja provjeravati u svjetlu Evanđelja i usmjerenosti na Krista, a ne shvatiti kao predviđanje budućnosti ili novu obvezujuću objavu.
concerns: Izraz „proročko” ostaje neodređen; bio bi teološki problematičan kad bi se razumio kao tvrdnja o novoj javnoj objavi ili kao sigurno predskazanje bez crkvenog razlučivanja.
magisterium.enrichment: U kršćanskom smislu proročka riječ prvenstveno pomaže raspoznati Božju volju u sadašnjosti i odgovoriti na nju, a znakove vremena treba tumačiti u svjetlu Krista i Evanđelja. Krunica je marijanska molitva koja vjernike vodi kontemplaciji Kristovih otajstava, pa njezino javno svjedočenje može biti znak žive vjere i zajedničke molitve, ali ne zamjenjuje liturgiju ni konačnu javnu Objavu.

magisterium.assessment_en: The description of the public praying of the Rosary as a possible sign of the times and "something prophetic" is generally aligned with Catholic teaching, especially because the speaker presents his assessment cautiously, rather than as a certain revelation. Such an interpretation should be examined in the light of the Gospel and Christ-centeredness, and not understood as a prediction of the future or a new binding revelation.
magisterium.enrichment_en: In the Christian sense, the prophetic word primarily helps discern God's will in the present and respond to it, and the signs of the times should be interpreted in the light of Christ and the Gospel. The Rosary is a Marian prayer that leads the faithful to the contemplation of the mysteries of Christ, so its public witness can be a sign of living faith and communal prayer, but it does not replace the liturgy nor definitive public Revelation.
concerns_en: The term "prophetic" remains indeterminate; it would be theologically problematic if understood as an assertion of a new public revelation or as a certain foretelling without ecclesial discernment.

sections.subtitle_en: "Something prophetic": the Rosary as a saving hand for a world hurtling toward ruin
sections.screenshot_description_en: Bishop Košić says that the public prayer of the Rosary is a prophetic sign of the times
sections.content_en:
Msgr. Košić articulates the most powerful thought of this part of the conversation when he reflects on the broader meaning of the movement. When he *thinks a little more* about it, he says, it seems to him that it is a **sign of the times**. He admits himself that he does not know exactly what kind of sign this is, but in this phenomenon he sees *something prophetic*. He emphasizes that the movement did not originate only in Croatia. Before that, it existed in **Poland**, and elsewhere men gathered who wanted to witness to their faith precisely by praying the Rosary.

The bishop interprets this as a sign that **responsible Catholic men see how the world is hurtling toward ruin** and that in Mary they see, as he says searching for the right word, *a saving hand*. According to his words, those praying want Our Lady, through her intercession, to:

- **strengthen Catholic men**,
- **reinforce Catholic families**, so that they would truly be what they ought to be,
- help the faithful **resist the onslaughts and snares** that are placed before them today.

He concludes his reflection with a serious diagnosis of the contemporary moment: as the viewers themselves see, *there is increasingly more evil into which the entire world is sinking*. He therefore does not perceive the public prayer of the Rosary as folklore or as a demonstration, but as a spiritual response to the crisis of the times.

sections.subtitle: Promrzli prsti i utihnuli vjetar: sisačko svjedočanstvo i skromnost biskupa
sections.screenshot_description: Biskup Košić skromno odbacuje pripisivanje nadnaravnih moći svom blagoslovu
sections.content:
Voditelj ističe da je moliteljima mnogo značilo kada je biskup došao, **kleknuo s njima i molio**. Prema voditeljevim riječima, to je bilo lijepo svjedočanstvo. Zatim prenosi dirljivu priču koju su ispričala „braća iz Siska“. Na siječanjskoj molitvi u Sisku bilo je **jako hladno**, puhao je snažan vjetar i moliteljima su se smrzavale ruke. Upravo tada stigao je biskup i podijelio blagoslov. Čim je počela molitva, osjetili su kako se **promrzlim prstima vraća toplina** i kako im *krv ponovno kola venama*. Kako tvrde, vrijeme se smirilo, a vjetar je utihnuo. Molitelji su to povezali s biskupovim blagoslovom i autoritetom. Voditelj ga zato pita je li svjestan *moći blagoslova* koju ima kao biskup.

Sugovornik napominje da to iskustvo može biti i subjektivno, ali da je riječ o lijepom svjedočanstvu. Mons. Košić odgovara s vidljivom suzdržanošću. Priču je i sam čuo, ali kaže da se *ne bi tako izjasnio*. **„Nemam ja nikakve nadzemaljske moći“**, naglašava. Sebe vidi kao **slugu Crkve i Kristova**.

Ipak, vrijednost blagoslova ne umanjuje. Podsjeća da mu i sama riječ kaže da *blago djeluje na ljude*. Zazivati Božje ime i zaštitu Blažene Djevice Marije za ljude i za cijeli svijet sigurno je, kako kaže, *korisno i djelotvorno*. Priču zaključuje slikovito: blagoslov može pomoći da se *otope neki ledovi i snjegovi*, ali to radije tumači kao **duhovnu nego kao fizičku stvarnost**.

magisterium.assessment: Biskupovo zajedničko klečanje i molitva s vjernicima dobro izražavaju zajedništvo Crkve i poštovanje prema krunici, a blagoslov je u skladu s katoličkom praksom. Ipak, opis topline nakon blagoslova treba shvatiti kao osobno svjedočanstvo, a ne kao dokaz čudesnog ozdravljenja ili zajamčenog tjelesnog učinka molitve.
concerns: Ako se priča iznosi kao dokaz da je biskupov blagoslov nadnaravno uzrokovao povratak topline ili obnovio cirkulaciju, to bi bio zaključak koji sam opis ne može utvrditi.
Molitva i blagoslov ne zamjenjuju uobičajena prirodna sredstva zaštite zdravlja i liječenja.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva cijeni krunicu kao zajedničku molitvu koja povezuje razmatranje Kristova života s nastojanjem da se vjera živi; blagoslov je molitva Crkve, a ne čarobni postupak ni jamstvo određenog osjetnog učinka. Sveto pismo prikazuje molitvu za ozdravljenje i darove ozdravljanja, ali crkvena uputa istodobno naglašava da molitva potiče, a ne isključuje, učinkovita prirodna sredstva za očuvanje i povrat zdravlja. Zato se iz jednog prepričanog iskustva može posvjedočiti što su molitelji osjetili, ali se ne može zaključiti da je potvrđen nadnaravni događaj; za takve tvrdnje potrebna je razborita prosudba.

magisterium.assessment_en: The bishop's kneeling and praying together with the faithful well express the communion of the Church and respect for the Rosary, and the blessing is in accordance with Catholic practice. Nevertheless, the description of warmth after the blessing should be understood as a personal testimony, and not as proof of miraculous healing or a guaranteed physical effect of prayer.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church values the Rosary as a communal prayer that unites contemplation of the life of Christ with the effort to live out the faith; a blessing is a prayer of the Church, not a magical procedure or a guarantee of a specific sensible effect. Sacred Scripture depicts prayer for healing and gifts of healing, but Church instruction simultaneously emphasizes that prayer encourages, rather than excludes, effective natural means for the preservation and restoration of health. Therefore, from a single recounted experience one can testify to what the pray-ers felt, but one cannot conclude that a supernatural event has been confirmed; such claims require prudent judgment.
concerns_en: If the story is presented as proof that the bishop's blessing supernaturally caused the return of warmth or restored circulation, that would be a conclusion that the description itself cannot establish.
Prayer and blessing do not replace the customary natural means of health protection and medical treatment.

sections.subtitle_en: Frozen fingers and quieted wind: Sisak testimony and the bishop's modesty
sections.screenshot_description_en: Bishop Košić modestly rejects attributing supernatural powers to his blessing
sections.content_en:
The host emphasizes that it meant a lot to the pray-ers when the bishop came, **knelt with them, and prayed**. According to the host's words, it was a beautiful testimony. Then he conveys a touching story told by the "brothers from Sisak." At the January prayer in Sisak, it was **very cold**, a strong wind was blowing, and the pray-ers' hands were freezing. Just then, the bishop arrived and imparted a blessing. As soon as the prayer began, they felt **warmth returning to their frozen fingers** and *blood circulating through their veins again*. As they claim, the weather calmed down, and the wind quieted. The pray-ers connected this with the bishop's blessing and authority. The host therefore asks him whether he is aware of the *power of the blessing* he has as a bishop.

The interlocutor notes that this experience may also be subjective, but that it is a beautiful testimony. Msgr. Košić responds with visible restraint. He heard the story himself, but says he *would not express it that way*. **"I have no unearthly powers,"** he emphasizes. He sees himself as a **servant of the Church and of Christ**.

Nevertheless, he does not diminish the value of a blessing. He recalls that the word itself indicates that it *has a gentle effect on people*. Invoking God's name and the protection of the Blessed Virgin Mary for people and for the whole world is certainly, as he says, *beneficial and effective*. He concludes the story figuratively: a blessing can help *melt certain ices and snows*, but he prefers to interpret this as a **spiritual rather than a physical reality**.

sections.subtitle: Hod za život nije politika, nego kršćanska i moralna obveza
sections.screenshot_description: Mons. Košić objašnjava da podrškom Hodu za život ne podupire nijednu političku stranku
sections.content:
Osim pokreta javne molitve krunice, voditelj ističe da biskup daje potporu i **pokretu za život**. Sudjelovao je i na prvom sisačkom **Hodu za život**. Mons. Košić pojašnjava da je na Hodu sudjelovao više puta. Nije siguran je li bio baš na svakom, ali koliko zna, ove bi godine trebalo biti sedmo ili osmo izdanje. Dolazi i ovaj put: Hod za život kroz Sisak ponovno se održava **20. lipnja**.

Odlučno odbacuje tvrdnje da je riječ o političkoj manifestaciji. Kako kaže, neki je *žele tako prikazati*. Neki su čak i njega ukorili da se time ne bavi jer je to navodno politika u koju se *biskup ne treba pačati*. Njegov odgovor kritičarima jasan je: **ne čini to iz političkih razloga i ne podupire nijednu političku stranku**. Podupire svijest da su vjernici dužni **braniti život od začeća do prirodne smrti**.

To naziva *kršćanskom i moralnom obvezom*. U toj se ulozi, objašnjava, pojavljuje kao vjernik, ali i kao autoritet, na što se nadovezuje na voditeljevo ranije pitanje. Svoju poziciju sažima rečenicom koja ne ostavlja mjesta dvojbi: ako je on onaj koji vodi Crkvu, onda *ne može, neće i ne smije biti protiv života*.

magisterium.assessment: Potpora Hodu za život i zauzimanje za zaštitu ljudskog života u skladu su s katoličkim naukom, koji poziva vjernike da brane ljudsko dostojanstvo i život od njegova početka do njegova prirodnog završetka. Ipak, tvrdnju da Hod „nije politika” treba razumjeti kao odbacivanje stranačke ili partijske pripadnosti, a ne kao poricanje da javno zagovaranje zaštite života ima društvene i političke posljedice.
concerns: U dostavljenom ulomku tvrdnja o nepolitičkom karakteru Hoda nije dodatno objašnjena; bez razlike između stranačke politike i javnog djelovanja za opće dobro može ostati nejasna.
magisterium.enrichment: Katoličko učenje podupire javno zauzimanje za zaštitu života: biskupi naglašavaju da pobačaj i eutanazija izravno ugrožavaju ljudski život te pozivaju na zakone i mjere koje štite život i pomažu trudnicama, djeci i obiteljima. Sveto pismo prikazuje život u majčinoj utrobi kao život koji je Bogu poznat i pod njegovom brigom, a crkveni nauk političko djelovanje vjernika usmjerava prema dostojanstvu svake osobe i općem dobru, ne samo prema stranačkim interesima.

magisterium.assessment_en: Support for the Walk for Life and advocacy for the protection of human life are in accordance with Catholic teaching, which calls the faithful to defend human dignity and life from its beginning to its natural end. However, the claim that the Walk “is not politics” should be understood as a rejection of party or partisan affiliation, and not as a denial that public advocacy for the protection of life has social and political consequences.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic teaching supports public engagement in defense of life: bishops emphasize that abortion and euthanasia directly threaten human life and call for laws and measures that protect life and assist pregnant women, children, and families. Sacred Scripture portrays life in the mother's womb as a life known to God and under his care, and Church teaching directs the political activity of the faithful toward the dignity of every person and the common good, not merely toward partisan interests.
concerns_en: In the provided excerpt, the claim about the non-political character of the Walk is not further explained; without a distinction between party politics and public action for the common good, it may remain unclear.

sections.subtitle_en: The Walk for Life is not politics, but a Christian and moral obligation
sections.screenshot_description_en: Mons. Košić explains that by supporting the Walk for Life he does not support any political party
sections.content_en:
Apart from the public Rosary prayer movement, the host points out that the bishop also gives support to the **movement for life**. He also participated in the first Sisak **Walk for Life**. Mons. Košić clarifies that he has participated in the Walk multiple times. He is not sure if he was at every single one, but as far as he knows, this year should be the seventh or eighth edition. He is coming this time as well: the Walk for Life through Sisak is being held again on **June 20**.

He resolutely rejects claims that it is a political manifestation. As he says, some *want to portray it that way*. Some have even rebuked him not to deal with it because it is supposedly politics in which a *bishop should not meddle*. His response to critics is clear: **he does not do it for political reasons and does not support any political party**. He supports the awareness that the faithful are obliged to **defend life from conception to natural death**.

He calls this a *Christian and moral obligation*. In that role, he explains, he appears as a believer, but also as an authority, following up on the host's earlier question. He summarizes his position with a sentence that leaves no room for doubt: if he is the one who leads the Church, then he *cannot, will not, and must not be against life*.

sections.subtitle: Ponoćka pred kamerama: propovijed za nerođene
sections.screenshot_description: Biskup prepričava božićnu propovijed o zaštiti nerođenog života prenošenu na televiziji
sections.content:
Kao primjer svoje dosljednosti mons. Košić prisjeća se jedne **ponoćke u sisačkoj katedrali**, još prije potresa. Misu je tada snimala televizija. Propovijed je pripremio svjesno, znajući da je te godine trebao biti donesen novi zakon. Prema njegovim riječima, jedan sud (ne sjeća se je li bio Ustavni ili Vrhovni) naložio je da se sljedeće godine *ispravi zakon iz Jugoslavije* i donese novi propis o **zaštiti čovjekova života od začeća**. To se, kako napominje, nije dogodilo.

U propovijedi se pozvao na riječi jedne dobitnice nagrade za mir: **ne može biti mira u svijetu ako se ne poštuje život**. Biskup razvija tu logiku. Ako se smije ubiti nerođeno dijete, koje se ne može braniti, *što će onda biti s onima koji se mogu braniti?* Tada se, upozorava, *može sve ubijati*. Upravo se to, smatra, i događa jer se život zapravo ne štiti.

I ta je propovijed izazvala kritike. Neki su mu zamjerili što je *iskoristio priliku* kada je bila prisutna televizija. Biskup ne odstupa: govorio je baš zato da njegove riječi *dopru do ušiju barem nekih* koji trebaju odgovorno postupati s ljudskim životom, s nerođenim čovjekom i djetetom. Htio je javno pokazati da se **katolici zalažu za život**. „I tu nemam ja dileme“, zaključuje.

magisterium.assessment: Zagovaranje zaštite ljudskog života od začeća u skladu je s katoličkim naukom o svetosti i nepovredivosti svakoga ljudskog života, uključujući nerođeno dijete. Budući da je odlomak prepričan i nedovršen, ne može se procijeniti sadržaj cijele propovijedi ni točnost povijesno-pravne tvrdnje o sudskoj odluci.
concerns: Nije jasno na koji se sud, odluku ili konkretan propis govornik poziva; tu bi povijesno-pravnu tvrdnju trebalo provjeriti, ali sama po sebi ne predstavlja teološki problem.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva uči da se ljudski život mora poštovati i štititi od začeća te da nerođeno dijete ima nepovredivo pravo na život. Premda Sveto pismo ne osuđuje pobačaj izričito tim nazivom, njegovo poštovanje čovjeka u majčinoj utrobi podupire moralni zaključak da se zapovijed „Ne ubij“ odnosi i na nerođeno dijete.
magisterium.assessment_en: Advocating for the protection of human life from conception is in accordance with Catholic teaching on the sanctity and inviolability of every human life, including the unborn child. Since the passage is recounted and incomplete, the content of the entire homily nor the accuracy of the historical-legal claim regarding the court decision cannot be assessed.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church teaches that human life must be respected and protected from conception and that the unborn child has an inviolable right to life. Although Sacred Scripture does not explicitly condemn abortion by that name, its reverence for man in the mother's womb supports the moral conclusion that the commandment "Thou shalt not kill" also applies to the unborn child.
concerns_en: It is not clear which court, decision, or concrete regulation the speaker is referring to; that historical-legal claim should be verified, but in itself does not present a theological problem.

sections.subtitle_en: Midnight Mass before the cameras: a homily for the unborn
sections.screenshot_description_en: The bishop recounts a Christmas homily on the protection of unborn life broadcast on television
sections.content_en:
As an example of his consistency, Msgr. Košić recalls a **Midnight Mass in the Sisak Cathedral**, even before the earthquake. Mass was being filmed by television at the time. He prepared the homily deliberately, knowing that a new law was supposed to be passed that year. According to his words, a court (he does not remember whether it was the Constitutional or the Supreme Court) ordered that the following year the *law from Yugoslavia be corrected* and a new regulation be passed on the **protection of human life from conception**. That, as he notes, did not happen.

In the homily, he referred to the words of a peace prize winner: **there can be no peace in the world if life is not respected**. The bishop develops that logic. If it is permitted to kill an unborn child, who cannot defend itself, *what will then happen to those who can defend themselves?* Then, he warns, *everything can be killed*. That, he believes, is precisely what is happening because life is not actually being protected.

And that homily provoked criticism. Some reproached him for having *used the opportunity* when television was present. The bishop does not back down: he spoke precisely so that his words would *reach the ears of at least some* who need to act responsibly with human life, with the unborn human being and child. He wanted to show publicly that **Catholics stand for life**. "And there I have no dilemma," he concludes.

sections.subtitle: „Psi laju, karavana prolazi“: medijski napadi i mjesto laika u Crkvi
sections.screenshot_description: Mons. Košić odgovara na pitanje o medijskim napadima i ističe da je Crkva prije svega zajednica vjernika laika
sections.content:
Voditelj primjećuje da je biskup zbog otvorenosti prema pokretima koje su prije svega pokrenuli laici često na **meti medija**. Pita ga kako te napade proživljava i kako se nosi sa svim tim naslovima.

Mons. Košić odgovor počinje eklesiološkom lekcijom, temom koju je i sam predavao. **Crkva nisu samo biskupi ni svećenici, dapače, većinu Crkve čine vjernici laici.** Zato, kaže, biskupi ne mogu biti oni koji određuju što će se, a što neće pokretati u Crkvi. Njihova je zadaća drugačija: *prepoznati ono što je dobro i to poduprijeti*.

Zatim postavlja retorička pitanja. Kako bi mogao biti protiv inicijative koja je u biti dobra i ima dobar cilj? *Kako bi biskup mogao biti protiv krunice, protiv molitve?* Ili reći da su oni koji se bore za zaštitu života na krivom putu? Biskup, smatra, treba iznositi moralni stav Katoličke crkve, a svatko može sam pogledati što piše u **Katekizmu Katoličke crkve**. Takve prigovore ne može ni dovesti u pitanje: *samo odmahne rukom*.

Napade ne poriče: zna da postoje i da ga ne štede. Ali komentira ih poslovicom **„psi laju, karavana prolazi“**. Smatra da su prolazni, *neka moda*, i da neki napadima traže priliku da se o njima govori, svejedno dobro ili loše. Današnji medijski svijet, upozorava, *pun je zamki*. Vjernici ne trebaju i ne žele medijsku slavu. Pozivajući se na **svetog Pavla**, zaključuje da se dobro čini bez obzira na to hoće li ljudi pljeskati ili gađati kamenjem, bilo to zgodno ili nezgodno, jer treba **braniti istinu i činiti dobro**. To, kaže, smatra svojom dužnošću.

magisterium.assessment: Tvrdnja da Crkvu čine svi krštenici, a ne samo biskupi i svećenici, usklađena je s katoličkim naukom: laici imaju stvaran udio u poslanju Crkve. Ipak, rečenica da biskupi „ne mogu biti oni koji određuju što će se, a što neće pokretati u Crkvi” zvuči previše apsolutno; ako se time poriče njihova služba poučavanja, upravljanja i razlučivanja, bila bi teološki netočna, premda nedovršeni ulomak možda pojašnjava namjeru govornika.
concerns: Položaj i odgovornost laika ne znače da crkvene inicijative djeluju neovisno o hijerarhijskom zajedništvu: biskupima je povjerena apostolska služba poučavanja, posvećivanja i upravljanja, dok se različite službe i karizme ostvaruju u uređenom zajedništvu Crkve.
Budući da se odlomak prekida nakon riječi „prepoznati...”, nije moguće pouzdano procijeniti kako govornik dalje objašnjava biskupsku ulogu.
magisterium.enrichment: Krštenjem svi vjernici sudjeluju u poslanju Krista i Crkve, a laici imaju vlastit poziv i odgovornost za apostolat; to ne čini njihove darove manje važnima. Istodobno, Crkva je zajedništvo različitih službi: biskupska služba nije suparnička laičkom apostolatu, nego mu služi i pomaže da se darovi razlučuju i usmjeravaju prema zajedničkom dobru.

magisterium.assessment_en: The claim that the Church is made up of all the baptized, and not only bishops and priests, is aligned with Catholic teaching: the laity have a real share in the mission of the Church. Nevertheless, the sentence that bishops "cannot be the ones who determine what will and what will not be initiated in the Church" sounds too absolute; if this denies their office of teaching, governing, and discerning, it would be theologically inaccurate, although the unfinished excerpt may clarify the speaker's intention.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Through baptism, all the faithful participate in the mission of Christ and the Church, and the laity have their own calling and responsibility for the apostolate; this does not make their gifts any less important. At the same time, the Church is a communion of diverse ministries: the episcopal ministry is not a rival to the lay apostolate, but serves it and helps gifts to be discerned and directed toward the common good.
concerns_en: The position and responsibility of the laity do not mean that ecclesial initiatives operate independently of hierarchical communion: bishops are entrusted with the apostolic ministry of teaching, sanctifying, and governing, while various ministries and charisms are realized within the ordered communion of the Church.
Since the excerpt breaks off after the word "recognize...", it is not possible to reliably assess how the speaker further explains the episcopal role.

sections.subtitle_en: "The dogs bark, the caravan passes": media attacks and the place of the laity in the Church
sections.screenshot_description_en: Msgr. Košić answers a question about media attacks and points out that the Church is first and foremost a community of lay faithful
sections.content_en:
The host notes that, due to his openness toward movements initiated primarily by the laity, the bishop is often a **media target**. He asks him how he experiences these attacks and how he deals with all those headlines.

Msgr. Košić begins his answer with an ecclesiological lesson, a subject he himself taught. **The Church is not only bishops or priests; indeed, the majority of the Church is made up of lay faithful.** Therefore, he says, bishops cannot be the ones who determine what will and what will not be initiated in the Church. Their task is different: *to recognize what is good and support it*.

He then asks rhetorical questions. How could he be against an initiative that is inherently good and has a good goal? *How could a bishop be against the Rosary, against prayer?* Or say that those fighting for the protection of life are on the wrong path? A bishop, he believes, should express the moral stance of the Catholic Church, and anyone can look for themselves at what is written in the **Catechism of the Catholic Church**. He cannot even bring such objections into question: *he simply waves his hand*.

He does not deny the attacks: he knows they exist and that they do not spare him. But he comments on them with the proverb **"the dogs bark, the caravan passes"**. He considers them fleeting, *a kind of fashion*, and that some seek through attacks an opportunity to be talked about, whether good or bad. Today's media world, he warns, *is full of traps*. The faithful neither need nor want media fame. Referring to **Saint Paul**, he concludes that good is done regardless of whether people will applaud or throw stones, in season or out of season, because one must **defend the truth and do good**. That, he says, he considers his duty.

sections.subtitle: Stepinac kao zaštitnik: spoj vjere i domoljublja
sections.screenshot_description: Biskup Košić govori o blaženom Alojziju Stepincu kao svom zaštitniku i uzoru
sections.content:
Na pitanje odakle crpi snagu i tko mu je sveti zaštitnik, mons. Košić odgovara epizodom iz razgovora s **apostolskim nuncijem, nadbiskupom Linguom**. Nuncij ga je ispitivao o nekim stvarima jer su ga, kako kaže, *neki napadali i tužili*. Biskup mu je tada odgovorio: **„Ja slijedim blaženog Alojzija Stepinca.“**

Objašnjava i zašto. Stepinac je blaženik Katoličke crkve koji je **branio istinu**. Govorio je **protiv komunizma**, **protiv nacizma**, protiv svakog zločina i protiv zatiranja ljudskih prava. Ako je to bilo ispravno za blaženika, zaključuje biskup, *valjda i on ima pravo* jednako zastupati ono što je za dobro čovjeka i naroda.

Posebno ističe da je Stepinac bio **osobiti ljubitelj svoga naroda** i da je **spajao vjeru i domoljublje**. Mons. Košić smatra da je i sam na neki način upio taj spoj, ponajviše kroz vlastita ratna iskustva.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je u skladu s katoličkim naukom: vjerničko nasljedovanje blaženoga Alojzija Stepinca predstavljeno je kao nasljedovanje svjedoka Krista koji je branio istinu, ljudska prava i žrtve zločina. To je sukladno crkvenom prikazu Stepinca kao pastira koji se opirao fašizmu, nacizmu i komunizmu te je branio progonjene.
magisterium.enrichment: Ivanovo evanđelje povezuje služenje Kristu s nasljedovanjem njega (Iv 12,26), a u govoru prigodom Stepinčeve beatifikacije papa Ivan Pavao II. prikazuje ga kao pastira koji je slijedio Dobroga Pastira i osuđivao ubijanje nevinih i druge nepravde. Crkveni nauk također u obrani ljudskih prava vidi obranu dostojanstva svake osobe, utemeljenog na ljudskoj naravi i Božjem daru. Važno je da nasljedovanje Stepinca znači vjernost Kristu, istini i ljubavi prema svim ljudima, a ne nekritičko poistovjećivanje vjere s bilo kojom političkom ideologijom.

citations.document_title: Apostolic Journey to Croatia: Beatification of the Servant of God Alojzije Stepinac (Shrine of Marija Bistrica)(3 October 1998)

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is in accordance with Catholic teaching: the faithful imitation of Blessed Alojzije Stepinac is presented as following a witness of Christ who defended the truth, human rights, and the victims of crimes. This is consistent with the Church's depiction of Stepinac as a shepherd who resisted fascism, Nazism, and communism, and defended the persecuted.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Gospel of John connects serving Christ with following him (Jn 12:26), and in his address on the occasion of Stepinac's beatification, Pope John Paul II portrays him as a shepherd who followed the Good Shepherd and condemned the killing of the innocent and other injustices. Church teaching also sees in the defense of human rights the defense of the dignity of every person, grounded in human nature and God's gift. It is important that following Stepinac means fidelity to Christ, truth, and love toward all people, rather than an uncritical identification of faith with any political ideology.

sections.subtitle_en: Stepinac as a patron: the union of faith and patriotism
sections.screenshot_description_en: Bishop Košić speaks about Blessed Alojzije Stepinac as his patron and role model
sections.content_en:
To the question of where he draws strength and who his patron saint is, Msgr. Košić responds with an episode from a conversation with the **Apostolic Nuncio, Archbishop Lingua**. The Nuncio questioned him about certain matters because, as he says, *some attacked and denounced him*. The bishop then replied to him: **"I follow Blessed Alojzije Stepinac."**

He also explains why. Stepinac is a blessed of the Catholic Church who **defended the truth**. He spoke **against communism**, **against Nazism**, against every crime, and against the suppression of human rights. If that was right for a blessed, the bishop concludes, *surely he too has the right* to equally advocate for what is for the good of man and the people.

He particularly emphasizes that Stepinac was **a special lover of his people** and that he **united faith and patriotism**. Msgr. Košić considers that he himself in some way absorbed that union, mostly through his own wartime experiences.

sections.subtitle: David protiv Golijata: pravedan rat i stotine krunica za branitelje
sections.screenshot_description: Mons. Košić govori o Domovinskom ratu kao pravednom obrambenom ratu i o krunicama koje je dijelio braniteljima
sections.content:
Nadovezujući se na ratna iskustva, biskup odlučno odbacuje relativizaciju rata. Odbija sliku prema kojoj su *jedni i drugi zli ili dobri, svi jednaki* i *tuku se bez veze, ne zna se zašto*. „Pa nije tako“, kaže. S jedne strane bila je **agresija i napad na nevine ljude**, a s druge strane **obrana koja je imala pravednu oznaku**. Bio je to, naglašava, **pravedan, obrambeni rat** i strane ne može izjednačiti *u svojoj savjesti*.

Podsjeća na riječi **kardinala Kuharića** da je to bilo *čudo Božje*. Poseže za biblijskom slikom: ako se David odupro Golijatu i nadvladao ga, Bog je bio s njim. Prema tome je, zaključuje, *Bog bio i s Hrvatima* kada su se u nemogućim okolnostima izborili za opstanak. Pritom ističe da nije bila riječ o tome tko će koga nadjačati, nego o pitanju **biti ili ne biti**.

Zato je, kaže, krunica tada bila iznimno važna. Biskup je **podijelio stotine krunica hrvatskim braniteljima**. Ona je označavala Božju zaštitu i zaštitu Blažene Djevice Marije, ali je donosila i obvezu. Tko nosi krunicu oko vrata, treba biti vjeran svojoj katoličkoj vjeri, zaštiti Majke Božje i **križu Kristovu** koji visi na kraju krunice. To je, smatra, bila pouka i za neprijatelje i za branitelje. Prisjeća se i tvrdnje da *takve vojske nikad nije bilo* koja bi na odori nosila krunicu: „To su imali Hrvati. I to nas obvezuje.“

magisterium.assessment: Tvrdnja da je agresija moralno različita od obrane napadnutih ljudi načelno je u skladu s katoličkim naukom: Crkva smatra agresorski rat nemoralnim, a napadnuta država može imati pravo i dužnost braniti se. Ipak, iz ovog odlomka samog nije moguće utvrditi jesu li u konkretnom slučaju ispunjeni svi strogi uvjeti za opravdanu uporabu sile, pa ocjenu rata kao pravednog treba razumjeti kao povijesno-moralni sud, a ne kao nešto što ovaj kratki isječak sam dokazuje.
concerns: Odlomak kategorički naziva rat pravednim, ali ne obrazlaže sve uvjete pravedne obrane: težinu i izvjesnost štete, iscrpljenost drugih sredstava, ozbiljne izglede za uspjeh te razmjernost posljedica.
Razlikovanje agresora i branitelja ne znači da su sva djela jedne strane opravdana niti da je u ratu „sve dopušteno”; moralna prosudba uzroka rata ne zamjenjuje prosudbu načina na koji se rat vodi.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički nauk ne izjednačava agresiju i legitimnu obranu, ali dopušta uporabu oružane sile samo pod strogim moralnim uvjetima, a njihovu primjenu procjenjuju odgovorni za opće dobro. Zato se može priznati moralna razlika između napadača i napadnutih, a istodobno zahtijevati da se svaka konkretna vojna odluka i postupak prosuđuju prema nužnosti, razmjernosti i poštovanju moralnih granica.

magisterium.assessment_en: The claim that aggression is morally different from the defense of attacked people is in principle in accordance with Catholic teaching: the Church considers a war of aggression immoral, and an attacked state may have the right and duty to defend itself. Nevertheless, from this excerpt alone it is not possible to determine whether in this specific case all the strict conditions for a justified use of force were met, so the assessment of the war as just should be understood as a historical-moral judgment, and not as something that this brief excerpt alone proves.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic teaching does not equate aggression and legitimate defense, but permits the use of armed force only under strict moral conditions, and their application is evaluated by those responsible for the common good. Therefore, the moral difference between attackers and the attacked can be recognized, while simultaneously requiring that every concrete military decision and action be judged according to necessity, proportionality, and respect for moral limits.
concerns_en: The passage categorically calls the war just, but does not explain all the conditions of a just defense: the gravity and certainty of the damage, the exhaustion of other means, serious prospects for success, and the proportionality of the consequences.

The distinction between aggressor and defenders does not mean that all actions of one side are justified, nor that in war "everything is permitted"; the moral judgment of the causes of war does not replace the judgment of the manner in which the war is conducted.

sections.subtitle_en: David against Goliath: a just war and hundreds of Rosaries for the defenders
sections.screenshot_description_en: Mons. Košić speaks about the Homeland War as a just defensive war and about the Rosaries he distributed to the defenders
sections.content_en:
Building on his wartime experiences, the bishop decisively rejects the relativization of war. He rejects the picture according to which *both sides are evil or good, everyone equal* and *fighting for no reason, nobody knows why*. "Well, it isn't so," he says. On one side there was **aggression and an attack on innocent people**, and on the other side **defense that had a just designation**. It was, he emphasizes, **a just, defensive war** and he cannot equate the sides *in his conscience*.

He recalls the words of **Cardinal Kuharić** that it was *a miracle of God*. He reaches for a biblical image: if David resisted Goliath and overcame him, God was with him. Therefore, he concludes, *God was also with the Croats* when, in impossible circumstances, they fought for their survival. At the same time, he points out that it was not a question of who would overpower whom, but a question of **to be or not to be**.

That is why, he says, the Rosary was extremely important then. The bishop **distributed hundreds of Rosaries to Croatian defenders**. It signified God's protection and the protection of the Blessed Virgin Mary, but it also brought an obligation. Whoever wears a Rosary around their neck should be faithful to their Catholic faith, to the protection of the Mother of God, and to the **cross of Christ** hanging at the end of the Rosary. That, he believes, was a lesson both for the enemies and for the defenders. He also recalls the claim that *there had never been such an army* that wore a Rosary on its uniform: "Croats had that. And that obligates us."

sections.subtitle: Hoće li papa Lav XIV. proglasiti Stepinca svetim?
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj pita biskupa o susretima s papama i o mogućoj kanonizaciji Stepinca
sections.content:
Voditelj podsjeća da se mons. Košić tijekom života susreo s nizom papa: od **Ivana Pavla II.**, preko **Benedikta** i **Franje**, do **pape Lava**. Pita ga kakvo je njegovo mišljenje o novom papi i vjeruje li da će upravo on proglasiti svetim blaženog Alojzija Stepinca.

Biskup odgovara bez oklijevanja: **vjeruje da hoće**. Dodaje da ni papa Franjo nije imao razloga da ga ne proglasi. Ipak, Franjo je, kako kaže, smatrao da je potrebno *zastati* i vidjeti koliko se može ići ususret **istočnim kršćanima**. Oni, prema biskupovim riječima, imaju neke svoje razloge, ali *imaju i mitove*.

magisterium.assessment: Izraženo uvjerenje da bi papa Lav XIV. mogao kanonizirati blaženog Alojzija Stepinca osobno je predviđanje, a ne tvrdnja koja proturječi katoličkom nauku ili Svetom pismu; u odlomku nema izravnog tumačenja biblijskog teksta. Spominjanje opreza pape Franje može se razumjeti kao prudencijalno razmatranje, no odlomak ne daje dovoljno podataka da bi se utvrdili njegovi razlozi ili ocijenilo stanje postupka.
concerns: Izraz da Franjo „nije imao razloga” ne kanonizirati Stepinca može zvučati kao da je kanonizacija samo pitanje papine volje; kanonizacijski postupak uključuje ozbiljno ispitivanje svjedočanstava, kreposti i, prema uobičajenoj proceduri, čuda te zahtijeva razboritu prosudbu.
Predviđanje da će ga papa Lav XIV. proglasiti svetim ostaje mišljenje sugovornika, a ne službena odluka ili nauk Crkve.
magisterium.enrichment: Kanonizacija je službeno crkveno priznanje svetosti i uključuje dopuštenje, odnosno proširenje javnog štovanja; crkveni izvori naglašavaju ozbiljnost i oprez takvog postupka. Blaženstvo i kanonizacija nisu isto: kanonizacijom se štovanje sveca proširuje na opću Crkvu, pa predviđanje o kanonizaciji ne treba poistovjećivati s već donesenom odlukom.

Implicazione dell'infallibilità nelle canonizzazioni dei santi, 2014, Issue 3, pp. 373–415

magisterium.assessment_en: The expressed belief that Pope Leo XIV could canonize Blessed Alojzije Stepinac is a personal prediction, not an assertion that contradicts Catholic teaching or Sacred Scripture; there is no direct interpretation of biblical text in the excerpt. The mention of Pope Francis's caution can be understood as a prudential consideration, but the excerpt does not provide sufficient data to determine his reasons or assess the status of the cause.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Canonization is the official ecclesiastical recognition of sanctity and includes permission for, that is, the extension of public veneration; Church sources emphasize the seriousness and caution of such a procedure. Beatification and canonization are not the same: through canonization, the veneration of a saint is extended to the universal Church, so a prediction about canonization should not be equated with an already made decision.
concerns_en: The expression that Francis "had no reason" not to canonize Stepinac may sound as if canonization is merely a matter of the pope's will; the canonization cause involves a serious examination of testimonies, virtues, and, according to standard procedure, miracles, and requires prudent judgment.
The prediction that Pope Leo XIV will declare him a saint remains the interlocutor's opinion, not an official decision or teaching of the Church.

sections.subtitle_en: Will Pope Leo XIV declare Stepinac a saint?
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host asks the bishop about encounters with popes and about the possible canonization of Stepinac
sections.content_en:
The host recalls that Mons. Košić met with a series of popes during his life: from **John Paul II**, through **Benedict** and **Francis**, to **Pope Leo**. He asks him what his opinion is of the new pope and whether he believes that he will be the one to declare Blessed Alojzije Stepinac a saint.

The bishop answers without hesitation: **he believes he will**. He adds that Pope Francis also had no reason not to declare him one. However, Francis, as he says, considered that it was necessary to *pause* and see how much one can reach out to the **Eastern Christians**. They, according to the bishop's words, have some of their own reasons, but *they also have myths*.

sections.subtitle: Zastoj iz 2014.: mitovi, mješovita komisija i istina koja se ne smije žrtvovati
sections.screenshot_description: Mons. Košić naglašava da se istina o Stepincu ne smije žrtvovati
sections.content:
Mons. Košić detaljno opisuje kako je došlo do zastoja kanonizacije. Prema njegovim riječima, **sastanci mješovite komisije pokazali su da argumenata protiv Stepinca nema**. Ljudi ipak, kaže, *žive u svojim umišljajima i strahovima*, a papa Franjo želio je da se to nekako ukloni pa je proces zaustavio.

Prisjeća se kronologije iz **2014. godine**. **Kardinal Amato** objavio je da je **Kongregacija za svece** završila sav posao i da preostaje samo da papa Stepinca proglasi svetim. To je učinio **10. veljače**, na blagdan blaženog Alojzija Stepinca, u **crkvi svetog Jeronima u Rimu**. Biskup smatra da se kardinal tada *malo zaletio* jer to nije bilo na njemu da kaže. Ipak, bio je jako radostan i želio je to podijeliti s Hrvatima, koje je volio. Već u travnju stigla je, međutim, **molba srpskog patrijarha** i proces je zaustavljen kako bi se vidjelo može li se pravoslavnoj strani nešto olakšati.

Biskup ne poriče da je papin napor donio i **mnogo dobra Crkvi u Hrvatskoj**. U tom su vremenu mnogi bolje upoznali lik blaženog Alojzija, kojega ranije nisu poznavali. Ali odlučno ponavlja: **„Istina se ne smije žrtvovati.“** Istina je, kaže, već dokazana, a *potvrdio ju je i dragi Bog* čudom po Stepinčevu zagovoru. Zato nema razloga da se proces ne završi, osim što će to *neke ljude ili neki narod boljeti*. Pritom se pita tko pita Katoličku crkvu kakve se svece proglašava u drugim crkvama.

Svoju obranu potkrepljuje činjenicama o Stepinčevu djelovanju. Postoje, kaže, pravi argumenti koji govore u prilog blaženiku: **činio je dobro i srpskom i židovskom narodu**, kao i mnogim nevjernicima koje je za vrijeme rata spašavao od progona. Biskupu je to jedna od Stepinčevih najvećih odlika. Bio je *čovjek velike širine duha* koji, kada je trebalo pomoći, *nije gledao tko je tko*, jer je bio **Božji čovjek**. Oni koji su u krivu, zaključuje, trebaju prihvatiti da nema nijednog argumenta i prihvatiti istinu.

magisterium.assessment: Naglasak da se istina ne smije žrtvovati u skladu je s katoličkim shvaćanjem svjedočenja za Krista, a sveti Ivan Pavao II. isticao je Stepinčevu vjernost istini, Crkvi i nasljedniku Petra te pozivao na oprost i pomirenje. Ipak, tvrdnje da je mješovita komisija dokazala kako nema argumenata protiv Stepinca te da je papa Franjo zaustavio postupak zbog umišljaja i strahova iznesene su kao zaključci bez potkrepe u dostupnim podacima, a trenutačni status Stepinca jest blaženik, ne kanonizirani svetac.
concerns: Prikaz razloga zastoja kao posljedice tuđih umišljaja ili strahova pripisuje motive i može unaprijed diskvalificirati legitimna pitanja o povijesnom kontekstu; dostavljeni izvori ne potvrđuju takvo objašnjenje.
Tvrdnja da su sastanci mješovite komisije pokazali kako argumenata protiv Stepinca nema nije potkrijepljena dostavljenim izvorima. Bez dodatnih dokaza ne treba je predstavljati kao utvrđen zaključak.

Navod da je 2014. preostalo samo da papa Stepinca proglasi svetim ne slaže se s njegovim navedenim aktualnim statusom: blažen je 1998., a uzrok je u dostavljenom pregledu i dalje označen kao beatifikacija.
magisterium.enrichment: Beatifikacija potvrđuje da se Stepinac može javno častiti u okviru koji je odredila Crkva, ali sama po sebi ne znači da je kanoniziran; dostavljeni crkveni pregled izričito ga navodi kao blaženika. Sveti Ivan Pavao II. opisao je njegovo svjedočanstvo kao vjernost istini i jedinstvu Crkve, ali je uz to naglasio oprost i pomirenje te pozvao da se zlo pobjeđuje dobrim, u skladu s Rim 12,21.

citations.document_title: Apostolic Journey to Croatia: Beatification of the Servant of God Alojzije Stepinac (Shrine of Marija Bistrica)(3 October 1998)

magisterium.assessment_en: The emphasis that the truth must not be sacrificed is in accordance with the Catholic understanding of witnessing for Christ, and Saint John Paul II emphasized Stepinac's fidelity to the truth, the Church, and the successor of Peter, calling for forgiveness and reconciliation. However, the claims that the mixed commission proved that there are no arguments against Stepinac and that Pope Francis stopped the process due to delusions and fears are presented as conclusions without support in the available data, and the current status of Stepinac is blessed, not a canonized saint.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Beatification confirms that Stepinac may be publicly venerated within the framework determined by the Church, but in itself does not mean that he is canonized; the provided ecclesiastical overview explicitly lists him as blessed. Saint John Paul II described his witness as fidelity to the truth and the unity of the Church, but along with that emphasized forgiveness and reconciliation and called for overcoming evil with good, in accordance with Rom 12:21.
concerns_en: Portraying the reasons for the stall as a consequence of others' delusions or fears attributes motives and may disqualify in advance legitimate questions about the historical context; the provided sources do not confirm such an explanation.

The claim that the meetings of the mixed commission showed that there are no arguments against Stepinac is not supported by the provided sources. Without additional evidence, it should not be presented as an established conclusion.

The statement that in 2014 it only remained for the Pope to declare Stepinac a saint does not agree with his stated current status: he was beatified in 1998, and the cause is still marked as beatification in the provided overview.

sections.subtitle_en: The 2014 stall: myths, the mixed commission, and the truth that must not be sacrificed
sections.screenshot_description_en: Msgr. Košić emphasizes that the truth about Stepinac must not be sacrificed
sections.content_en:
Msgr. Košić describes in detail how the canonization came to a standstill. According to his words, **the meetings of the mixed commission showed that there are no arguments against Stepinac**. People nevertheless, he says, *live in their delusions and fears*, and Pope Francis wanted that somehow to be removed, so he stopped the process.

He recalls the chronology from **2014**. **Cardinal Amato** announced that the **Congregation for the Causes of Saints** had finished all the work and that it only remained for the Pope to declare Stepinac a saint. He did so on **February 10**, on the feast day of Blessed Alojzije Stepinac, in the **Church of Saint Jerome in Rome**. The bishop considers that the cardinal *rushed ahead a bit* back then because that was not his to say. Still, he was very joyful and wanted to share it with Croats, whom he loved. Already in April, however, the **request of the Serbian Patriarch** arrived, and the process was stopped in order to see whether something could be eased for the Orthodox side.

The bishop does not deny that the Pope's effort also brought **much good to the Church in Croatia**. During that time, many came to know better the figure of Blessed Alojzije, whom they had not known before. But he resolutely repeats: **“The truth must not be sacrificed.”** The truth, he says, has already been proven, and *dear God also confirmed it* through a miracle through Stepinac's intercession. Therefore, there is no reason for the process not to be completed, except that it will *hurt some people or a certain nation*. At the same time, he wonders who asks the Catholic Church what kind of saints are proclaimed in other churches.

He corroborates his defense with facts about Stepinac's work. There are, he says, real arguments in favor of the blessed: **he did good to both the Serbian and Jewish people**, as well as to many non-believers whom he saved from persecution during the war. To the bishop, this is one of Stepinac's greatest virtues. He was a *man of great breadth of spirit* who, when it was necessary to help, *did not look at who was who*, because he was a **man of God**. Those who are wrong, he concludes, should accept that there is not a single argument and accept the truth.

sections.subtitle: Spomenik u Sisku i kozaračka djeca: „Siščani trebaju biti ponosni“
sections.screenshot_description: Biskup Košić govori o spašavanju kozaračke djece i spomeniku Stepincu s dvoje djece u Sisku
sections.content:
Mons. Košić prisjeća se izjave koja je, priznaje, mogla zvučati *malo provokativno*. Rekao je da bi ekumenski dijalog sa **Srpskom pravoslavnom crkvom** trebalo nastaviti *ako i kada podignu spomenik blaženom Alojziju Stepincu u Beogradu*. Za usporedbu navodi Sisak, gdje je održan simpozij i gdje je **2018. podignut spomenik Stepincu**, prikazanom zajedno s **dvoje djece**.

Simbolika nije slučajna. Stepinac je, objašnjava biskup, **spašavao djecu, među njima i kozaračku**. Pitanje „tko ih je ubijao“ biskup odbacuje tvrdnjom da ih *nitko nije ubijao*. Djeca su, prema njegovim riječima, stizala gladna, bolesna i već umiruća, i trebalo ih je zbrinuti. Stepinac je organizirao pomoć u kojoj su sudjelovali **katolički svećenici, časne sestre i obitelji**. Prema biskupovim riječima, uključili su se i liječnici, sestre iz državnih i crkvenih udruga te vjernici koji su djecu udomljavali.

Brojke koje navodi pokazuju razmjere te akcije:

- u grad je stiglo **otprilike 6000 djece**, što bi bio problem i za veliki Zagreb, a kamoli za manji grad u ratu i gladi,
- **oko 5000 ih je preživjelo**,
- nešto više od tisuću, *1100 negdje*, umrlo je, i to, naglašava biskup, **od gladi i bolesti, a ne nasilnom smrću**.

Preživjeli su i danas svjedoci da su ih spasili *dobri ljudi, naši sugrađani*. Zato mons. Košić ponavlja ono što je već više puta rekao: **Siščani trebaju biti ponosni** jer su spasili mnogo kozaračke, srpske ili pravoslavne djece, kako god ih tko nazvao. Tvrdnja da su Hrvati ubijali djecu duboko ga vrijeđa. „Ako već nisi zahvalan, nemoj biti toliko drzak da lažeš. Reci istinu, a ako nećeš, onda šuti“, poručuje, priznajući da je tada bio emotivan.

magisterium.assessment: Naglašavanje spašavanja djece i poštovanja Stepinčeva svjedočanstva u skladu je s katoličkim vrednovanjem obrane progonjenih, uključujući pravoslavne, ali kategoričke povijesne tvrdnje i uvredljiv ton nisu dovoljno uravnoteženi zahtjevima istine i pomirenja. Prikazani izvori ne potvrđuju navedene brojke ni tvrdnju da nitko nije ubijao djecu, pa se te činjenice ne mogu teološki ili povijesno potvrditi samo na temelju ovog odlomka.
concerns: Tvrdnja da djecu „nitko nije ubijao” te da su umrla isključivo od gladi i bolesti izrečena je kao konačan povijesni zaključak, ali zahtijeva pažljivo utvrđivanje činjenica; crkveni dokumenti upozoravaju i na apologetsko opravdavanje i na neutemeljeno pripisivanje krivnje.
Uvreda upućena onima koji osporavaju prikaz („nemoj biti toliko drzak… onda šuti”) može produbiti podjele umjesto potaknuti kršćanski dijalog, uzajamno slušanje i iscjeljenje povijesnih sjećanja.

Uvjetovanje nastavka ekumenskog dijaloga podizanjem spomenika u Beogradu može ostaviti dojam da je dijalog sredstvo pritiska; katolički pristup povezuje dijalog istine s dijalogom ljubavi i nastojanjem oko jedinstva, ne odričući se pritom povijesne istine.
magisterium.enrichment: Sveti Ivan Pavao II. opisao je blaženog Alojzija Stepinca kao branitelja Židova, pravoslavnih i svih progonjenih te je istaknuo njegovo svjedočenje protiv nepravde i ubijanja nevinih. Takvo priznanje ne ukida potrebu za preciznim istraživanjem pojedinačnih događaja: crkveno pomirenje traži istinu, izbjegava manipulaciju poviješću i nastoji očistiti sjećanje od mržnje i želje za osvetom.

magisterium.assessment_en: Emphasizing the rescue of children and respect for Stepinac's testimony is in accordance with the Catholic valuation of defending the persecuted, including the Orthodox, but categorical historical claims and an offensive tone are not sufficiently balanced with the demands of truth and reconciliation. The presented sources do not confirm the cited figures nor the claim that no one killed the children, so these facts cannot be theologically or historically confirmed based solely on this passage.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Saint John Paul II described Blessed Alojzije Stepinac as a defender of Jews, the Orthodox, and all the persecuted, and emphasized his testimony against injustice and the killing of the innocent. Such recognition does not eliminate the need for precise investigation of individual events: ecclesial reconciliation seeks the truth, avoids manipulation of history, and strives to purify memory from hatred and the desire for revenge.
concerns_en: The claim that „no one killed” the children and that they died exclusively from hunger and disease was uttered as a definitive historical conclusion, but it requires careful ascertainment of facts; church documents warn both against apologetic justification and against unfounded attribution of guilt.

The insult addressed to those who dispute the account („do not be so insolent… then be quiet”) can deepen divisions instead of fostering Christian dialogue, mutual listening, and the healing of historical memories.

Conditioning the continuation of ecumenical dialogue on the erection of a monument in Beograd can leave the impression that dialogue is a means of pressure; the Catholic approach links the dialogue of truth with the dialogue of love and the striving for unity, without thereby renouncing historical truth.

sections.subtitle_en: The monument in Sisak and Kozara children: „The people of Sisak should be proud“
sections.screenshot_description_en: Bishop Košić speaks about the rescue of Kozara children and the monument to Stepinac with two children in Sisak
sections.content_en:
Msgr. Košić recalls a statement that, he admits, could have sounded *a little provocative*. He said that ecumenical dialogue with the **Serbian Orthodox Church** should be continued *if and when they erect a monument to Blessed Alojzije Stepinac in Beograd*. For comparison, he cites Sisak, where a symposium was held and where **in 2018 a monument to Stepinac was erected**, depicted together with **two children**.

The symbolism is not accidental. Stepinac, the bishop explains, **rescued children, among them also Kozara children**. The question of „who was killing them“ the bishop rejects with the assertion that *no one was killing them*. The children, according to his words, arrived hungry, sick, and already dying, and they needed to be cared for. Stepinac organized aid in which **Catholic priests, nuns, and families** participated. According to the bishop's words, doctors, nurses from state and church associations, and the faithful who fostered the children also joined in.

The figures he cites show the scale of that operation:

- **approximately 6,000 children** arrived in the city, which would be a problem even for large Zagreb, let alone for a smaller town in war and famine,
- **around 5,000 of them survived**,
- slightly more than a thousand, *somewhere around 1,100*, died, and that, the bishop emphasizes, **from hunger and disease, and not by violent death**.

The survivors are even today witnesses that *good people, our fellow citizens* saved them. That is why Msgr. Košić repeats what he has already said multiple times: **the people of Sisak should be proud** because they saved many Kozara, Serbian, or Orthodox children, whatever anyone might call them. The claim that Croats killed children deeply offends him. „If you are not already grateful, do not be so insolent as to lie. Tell the truth, and if you will not, then be quiet“, he conveys, admitting that he was emotional at the time.

sections.subtitle: Dijalog da, ali ne pod cijenu istine
sections.screenshot_description: Mons. Košić objašnjava da katolički dijalog mora biti razborit i dostojanstven
sections.content:
Svoje stajalište o dijalogu biskup objašnjava osobnom usporedbom. Kada bi netko o njegovu ocu govorio da je bio ubojica ili nasilnik i pripisivao mu ono što nije činio, rekao bi mu da *prestane govoriti neistine* jer s njim tako ne može razgovarati. Prema njegovu mišljenju, to je **pitanje dostojanstva** i samog sugovornika i razine dijaloga.

Oštro kritizira, kako kaže, prividni dijalog u kojem se *grli i slika pred kamerama, jede, pije i slavi*, dok druga strana *drži nož iza leđa*. „Je li to dijalog koji bi trebao biti katolički dijalog?“, pita.

Njegov odgovor nije odbacivanje dijaloga. Naprotiv, naglašava da su katolici **apsolutno za dijalog** i da treba činiti sve kako bi se **približili istok i zapad**. Katolici se moraju znati suzdržati, biti *i diplomati* te ponegdje popustiti. Ali katolički dijalog mora biti **razborit dijalog**, a jedna granica ostaje nepomična: **istinu ne smijemo žrtvovati**.

magisterium.assessment: Naglasak da dijalog mora počivati na istini i uzajamnom poštovanju dostojanstva sugovornika u skladu je s katoličkim naukom; dijalog ne zahtijeva prešućivanje neistine niti prividan dogovor. Ipak, izraz da druga strana „drži nož iza leđa” može, ako nije potkrijepljen konkretnim dokazima ili se primjenjuje općenito, nepravedno pripisivati sugovornicima nepoštene namjere i oslabiti kršćanski duh dijaloga.
concerns: Metafora o „nožu iza leđa” može poticati sumnjičavost ili kolektivno pripisivanje zle namjere; katolički pristup traži istinoljubivost, ali i poštovanje, strpljivost te suzdržavanje od diskreditiranja onih s kojima se ne slažemo bez dostatnih razloga.
Iz dostavljenog odlomka nije moguće procijeniti jesu li konkretne tvrdnje o ponašanju druge strane činjenično utemeljene.
magisterium.enrichment: Katoličko shvaćanje dijaloga ne svodi ga na uljudno druženje ili kompromis: sudionici trebaju iskreno tražiti istinu, biti spremni saslušati je i ispraviti se, a lažni dogovor postignut obmanom nije pravi dijalog. Istodobno, vjernik treba istinu iznositi s blagošću i poštovanjem, kako potiče 1 Pt 3,15, te izbjegavati pripisivanje nepoštenih metoda bez osnove; zato je moguće odlučno osporiti neistinu, a ipak sačuvati pravednost i otvorenost prema sugovorniku.
